### System overview
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_2aebfa19` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:4056 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aESP is an active safety system. Its main function is to maximize the use of ground adhesion and maintain vehicle maneuverability and driving stability.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_c534e629` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:4057 | doc_type:owners_manual
When exceeding physical limits or driving at high speeds on slippery roads, the electronic stability control system cannot completely prevent the vehicle from slipping.

Hint:

Before diagnosing the ESP, check the parts that may cause ESP failure and are easily accessible. Visual inspection can quickly identify certain faults, making further diagnosis unnecessary.

### Initial check
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_3282cc3c` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:4058 | doc_type:owners_manual
(Check the vehicle tire to ensure that tires and hubs of the recommended size must be installed. Coaxial tires must have the same tread pattern and depth.   
Check the hydraulic regulator, brake line and connections of the ESP for leaks.   
Check the fuses of the ESP to ensure that they are not blown and are of the correct type.   
(Measure the battery voltage to check whether the battery wiring terminal is corroded or loose.   
Check whether the ground point of the ESP ground wire is loose and whether the ground position is changed.

### Warning:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_91893b40` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:4059 | doc_type:owners_manual
The ESP ground wire must be well sealed to prevent water and moisture from penetrating into the connector of the electronic stability control unit through the holes in the harness and causing functional failure.

Perform visual inspection on the following electrical components:

(Check whether the harness and connector of related ESP parts are properly connected or damaged.   
Check if the harness is too close to highvoltage or highcurrent devices, such as high-voltage components, after-sales retrofitted stereo amplifier, etc.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_4d26ae35` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:4060 | doc_type:owners_manual
High voltage or high current devices may cause the circuit to generate induced waves, which may interfere with the normal operation of the circuit.

(3) ESP components are sensitive to electromagnetic interference (EMI). If a intermittent failure is suspected, check whether the antitheft device, lamp or mobile phone installed after sales is installed correctly.

(If the ESP noise is excessive, check the following causes:

( The connection between the ESP assembly and the ESC bracket is loose.   
(The connection between the ESP bracket and the body is loose.   
(The rubber washer on the ESP bracket is missing or damaged.   
(4Brake line deformation, bump and interference.   
Brake line bracket clip damage.   
(h)Check vehicle driving conditions. If the physical limit is exceeded or when driving at high speed on wet and slippery roads, the ESP cannot completely prevent the vehicle from slipping.   
(i) Before troubleshooting the electrical equipment, check whether the fuse is normal.

### Maintenance of failure without DTC
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_e542c314` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:4061 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

If there is a fault in the brake system, but the ESC does not store a DTC, such a fault is called a fault without DTC.

### Maintenance of failure without DTC
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_6d0d60dd` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:4062 | doc_type:owners_manual
(The failure without DTC is generally caused by the failure of the foundation brake system, and occurs in the following situations:

Brake fluid leakage;   
Inferior brake fluid is used;   
Air in brake line;   
(4Brake line blockage;   
(5) Excessive brake disc wear;   
(6Booster system failure;   
7Brake line connection error.

If the warning lamp is always on but there is no DTC, it may be due to power supply failure or abnormal interruption of power supply of ESC. Hint: Correct the fault by checking the corresponding components for the fault phenomenon.

### Maintenance of random failure
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_fa80a1bd` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:4063 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a In electronic systems, there may be transient poor contact between electrical circuits and places where signals are input and output, resulting in random failure. Sometimes the random failure will disappear on its own, so it is not easy to find out what the problem is. When the random failure occurs, the fault can be simulated in the following way to check whether the fault will recur.

![](images/3eb8422d5ce4de541339ed4378abc6b38a08dc248af8a25cee6dc4968ba665c6.webp)

Hint:

If the fault does not reoccur at this time, wait until the fault reoccurs next time before performing a diagnostic repair. In general, random fault will gradually become reoccuring fault without being self-eliminated.

### Inspection procedure

The yaw rate sensor is integrated in the ESC. The yaw rate sensor contains three signals: lateral acceleration, longitudinal acceleration and yaw rate. When the sensor fails, the ESC records the DTC.

![](images/3e4caea43c05ca6e16af2727139c2f0c30e00c88f7a16fa6b8194315da773394.webp)

Check whether the yaw rate sensor installation is tight.   
(Check yaw rate sensor and fixing bracket for bending and wear.

Repair according to the fault

(Connect the HQ-VDS.   
Set the ignition switch to "ON".   
(Recalibrate the yaw rate sensor.   
(Clear the DTC.

### Precautions
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_0eb9207a` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:4166 | doc_type:owners_manual
ENGINE START/STOP button (ignition switch) representation: HEV

![](images/23081c109d890221401526fff80490a5d99b2a66127684be0d48742deb384ba0.webp)

2. Disconnect the cable from the battery negative terminal

Notice:

The initialization is required for some systems when the battery cable is disconnected and reconnected.

3. The IBC is a safety-related component. Therefore, in addition to general safety and precautions, the following diagnostic precautions must be observed when performing maintenance and diagnosis on it.

Operation precautions

(aThe IBC system must be repaired by technicians who has been professionally trained and has maintenance skills, and only the original part shall be used for replacement.   
Unless otherwise specified in the inspection procedure, make sure that the ignition switch is placed in the OFF position and the battery negative terminal is disconnected when the IBC electronic control unit and sensor etc are removed and installed.   
( Hold the IBC with both hands during handling. It is forbidden to grasp the oil reservoir, push rod, control unit plug and other vulnerable parts.

5IBC diagnosis and manual bleeding procedure (aConnect the HQ-VDS and establish communication. Ensure that the system is in installation mode. (Foundation brake exhausting.

(d) Connect the brake fluid pressurization device to a remote oi reservoir to provide an external pressure of 2 bar. Fill the brake system with brake fluid through the remote fluid reservoir, and pay attention to the filing speed to avoid the brake fluid spilling into the engine compartment and contaminating other spare parts.   
(e) Pedal at a certain pace and perform the base brake bleeding for all wheels from left rear, to left front, right front and right rear.   
(f) Turn of the power supply of the liquid filing, bleeding and pressurizing device.   
(9) Verify the leakage results: carry out IBC leakage and air detection (see the filling and bleeding document for details).   
(h) Evaluate the results of IBC leakage and air monitoring.   
(i) Remove external brake fluid pressurization equipment after venting Note: It is recommended to be performed 10 minutes later after adding liquid and venting.   
(j) Perform VCP calibration procedure.   
(k) Write the correct configuration word.   
(1) Calibrate steering angle sensor.   
(m) Turn off the IBC transport mode.   
(n) Use the HQ-VDS to send a command to reset the ECU.   
(o) Power on again and re-ignite, and check whether all warning lamps go out.

`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_f0bb070d` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:4172 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aThe IBC assembly consists of small oil reservoir with level sensor, mounting plate, push rod, control unit and hydraulic unit.

( The IBC is in a decoupled state under normal working mode, and the brake pedal feeling is simulated by PFS (pedal feel simulator).   
(If the IBC pedal sense is degraded to the mechanical backup mode (non-decoupling), the TMC brake circuit is directly connected to the brake wheel cylinder; The braking deceleration at this time is directly controlled by the driver.

After the vehicle enters the maintenance shop, the following information should be collected:

( The operation behavior before and after the fault occurs.   
Check whether there is a text prompt or the fault warning lamp lights up when the fault occurs.   
What is the frequency of fault and whether it is recovered after re-ignition.

(Establish the diagnosis and analyze the diagnostic results:

(Connect the HQ-VDS.   
(The self-test of the vehicle ends.   
(3) Establish communication to read and store DTC.   
(4) Analyze whether the DTC is current fault or historical fault.   
Query the solution according to the DTC.

### Inspection procedure
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_bea4bb95` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:4177 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/e27fee0fc4dcf31ef99c00ae3b87e9c9a886e31a278b657fe205900a2f70b231.webp)

(aConfirm whether the fault warning lamp is on when the fault occurs.   
Confirm the frequency of failure and whether it is random failure, etc.   
(Confirm the working condition, vehicle speed,accelerator/brake pedal status, etc. when the fault occurs.   
(Check whether the vehicle has been in an accident or repaired.   
(e) Check whether the vehicle power supply system is normal (such as whether the battery terminal is normal and whether the IBC fuse is damaged).   
(f) Check the IBC for bump or impact marks.   
(g) Check whether the IBC is installed correctly, check the brake fluid reservoir hose for leakage and check its grounding status.   
(hCheck the IBC connector connection status and check the connector for rust, false connection, water ingress, etc.   
(i) Check and repair according to the problems checked out.   
(j) Connect the HQ-VDS.   
(kSet the ignition switch to "ON". Read and store DTC.   
(m)Clear the DTC and power on and off again.   
Re-read the DTC.

`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_fa218e68` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:4300 | doc_type:owners_manual
(Check whether the brake fluid level in the vacuum booster reservoir is between the MAX and MIN marks.

### Change the braking fluid
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_8c291750` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:4301 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

If any operation is performed on the brake system or air is suspected in the brake line, the brake system should be bled.

Note:

Before bleeding the brake system, move the gearshift lever to the P gear position and apply the parking brake.

While bleeding the brake system, add brake fluid to keep the fluid level in the reservoir between the MIN and MAX lines.

If brake fluid is splashed on any painted or rubber surface, it shall be cleaned immediately.

Add the brake fluid to the reservoir and ensure that there is enough brake fluid in the reservoir.

![](images/7d95592a1a5e2b7103f32982fd49271170c11e70a2a457fd682a217970f7b660.webp)

(aIndividually loose the brake line nuts on the brake master cylinder by using a suitable tool.

(cRepeat several times until no bubbles are generated.

( Fasten the bleed screw.

### Check brake disc thickness

![](images/ea5c9269f67206d1dff671c460e0f068c0bcb4df8e7eca42eacfffccce4c3036.webp)

### Check brake disc radial runout.
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_061aa416` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:4313 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aSecure the front brake disc with brake disc locating screw and wheel bolt.   
(Wipe the brake disc friction ring surface with a clean cloth.   
(Radial runout of the hub bearing unit assembly.   
Measure the radial runout of the brake disc with a dial indicator at a distance of 10 mm from the outer edge of the front brake disc.

![](images/6308c42d199f47cc6a432701951ecd1f01b7c2a71ccd402c47ebb53dd8d48d74.webp)

Note:

Maximum brake disc radial runout: 0.06 mm

Hint:

The magnet of the dial indicator shall be kept away from the hub bearing unit assembly and the speed sensor.

Install the dial indicator on the shock absorber and if the radial runout exceeds the maximum, change the installation position of the brake disc on the hub bearing unit assembly to reduce the radial runout. If the radial runout still exceeds the maximum value after the installation position is changed, then grind brake disc. If the front brake disc axial runout exceeds the maximum value, replace the front brake disc.

`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_30b24fa5` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:4324 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

![](images/ebb46f1285d1936c672b0508b2d94f371d2a5682d8a55888ebcf5c709af728e5.webp)

![](images/6fe9c6a970d18aa9f392cc6eb9349d1a7dbccdcb375d35f8247245a7ccfac23f.webp)

The removal sequence on the right side is the same as that on the left side.

The order listed below applies to the left side.

Place the ignition switch in the ON position   
2. Connect the HQ-VDS to enter the service mode, and release the caliper.   
3. Remove the rear wheel (See page TW-3)

### Warning:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_90d284e0` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:4391 | doc_type:owners_manual
Before repairing the high voltage system or adjacent high voltage system components, be sure to carefully read the "Instructions and precautions for maintenance work" in the introduction carefully!

ENGINE START/STOP button (ignition switch) representation:

Conventional vehicle

![](images/bc97e71ec6b17584e379af7f4866cd264748215a39a5abf5cd89ac9ab147c1e1.webp)

HEV

![](images/e1df533e1caa2db44f73c03b63d63fb0d71d704a2b3ca08945189aa538b810f6.webp)

when the battery cable is disconnected and reconnected, some systems require initialization.

General repair instructions

When checking the seat control system, it may affect the airbag work. Therefore, before carrying out maintenance work, be sure to carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag.   
When the part needs to be replaced or the connector needs to be disconnected during maintenance of seat control system, disconnect the battery negative cable.

(The door control system needs to be initialized after reconnecting the battery. And use the HQVDS to "clear the DTC" for all electronic control systems.

The passenger seat is removed in the same order as the driver seat.

### Calibration
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_8c224b13` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:4787 | doc_type:owners_manual
Vertical angle measurement and correction

Open the level gauge;   
After checking the attachment end is free of debris, gently attach the level gauge -Ato the LCDA upper cover plane, and then gently move it twice to confirm whether it is completely attached;

![](images/e5cf2726f61cce56fe03d5969f6fc75f0f5eb86eb5a9494892c49dcca174337a.webp)

( After successful attachment, read the data on the level gauge-A-B;

![](images/5366588d74c30fd3d8763e94df50cde28a936876f9e747135c90e6edfe98a37c.webp)

If the angle error is within the range of 90±1 °, it is not necessary to adjust those that are considered acceptable (upward elevation is positive and downward elevation is negative); and then adjust those that are not acceptable in installation. (Adjustment method: shims can be set on the studs of LCDA bracket)

Hint:

When the radar is tilted down, a shim with a size of M6 and a thickness of 1mm can be placed at the lower screw. When the radar is tilted up, a shim with a size of M6 and a thickness of 1mm can be placed at the upper screw.

![](images/029045182ba049162419a6cd9e3dbb8ec0223641fe7ff9d23b84702ea2553e6e.webp)

Horizontal angle calibration process

Calibration requirements

Ensure that the wheel alignment has been done before the radar calibration.   
(2) Correct tire pressure.   
(The vehicle shall be parked steadily in the calibrated position with the ground as level as possible.   
(4During calibration, 1 person is seated in the driver seat.   
Parking brake activation.   
( The vehicle is in the IG ON power-on state.

Calibration equipment (Radar simulator and bracket. () HQ-VDS. Absorbing material wall.

(Calibration environment (The calibration circumstance diagram. Warning: (Only single targets of radar simulators are allowed in thecalibration environment; No person is allowed to enter the test area duringcalibration. (3) Absorbing material shall be placed on the 7 m boundaryline to block out the surroundings, and the absorbing material walls shall be arranged on the 7 m ×7 m boundary behind the rear bumper.

![](images/5cedc5dbd8b45cf5dd7526e221ea06e9b7354c2ffb0454ac68d53223c6089e57.webp)

![](images/d014a8aebf02002ab6049fc4c37c05a5e6f63e7db324c1a73453f902826b18bc.webp)

Schematic diagram of the aboveground marking line on the calibration site.

![](images/8e3a6164a0ea42473d67ff67f6e3042531ef780a2fe0251d5ea013a2cb1f9e2a.webp)

![](images/444036f4a058668ca78b13e1de1e7dfc9dffef4fb6d34c174f967ef49a700e83.webp)

![](images/15ebbc0577ac86be7514adbd608b66e7bfcffe0bf3044169bbf7859ecba4cc49.webp)

Calibration renderings, showing layout of radar simulators.

![](images/714892b178609968179cc8b76c07c65d892d62d360d943ca38322983b17c92f6.webp)

(4Radar simulator bracket diagram.

Hint:

The radar simulator bracket can adjust the height of the radar simulator according to different vehicle models to ensure that the height of the radar simulator is the same as that of the radar, and there are fixing devices on the radar pillars.

(dCalibration steps

(Ensure that the vehicle state is good.   
Drive the vehicle to be calibrated into the calibration line.   
(Place the radar simulator directly behind the left radar according to the placement position.   
(4 After determining the radar simulator calibration point, connect the HQ-VDS and issue the automatic calibration command to the radar.   
(Repeat the above procedures, and calibrate the right radar.

(eCommunication mode (1Communication mode: CAN. Baud rate: 500 kb.

() The HQ-VDS issues the calibration command. At this time, the radar enters the calibration mode. After the radar is successfully calibrated, it returns to the calibration end mark and the calibration state, and the radars on both sides are calibrated in turn.

Calibration results

After the radar calibration is completed, the results will be fed back to the upper computer to determine whether to calibrate the next vehicle or to perform manual intervention to correct the deviation.

Radar calibration results:

![](images/9d78d8a1044643e4307b274ba88a501baa5bdce895325a0e0943c65862197f2d.webp)

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_343a6d0d` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:4789 | doc_type:owners_manual
(1When the radar is installed in front of bumper made of different materials and there is reflection interference from other targets, additional errors may occur.   
Radar installation error refers to the angle error caused by the bracket and installation problems when the radar is installed on the bracket.

(hCalibration failure reasons

Automatic angle calibration may fail in the following cases

(1 The calibration equipment fails.   
The corner reflector is not placed directly in front of the radar.   
(The radar wave transmitted to the radar simulator is blocked.   
(4Excessive deviation of radar simulator placement.   
(5) Excessive radar installation deviation.   
(6) There is reflected interference from other targets similar to the radar simulator radial distance.   
(7There are stronger reflections from other targets within the target area.   
(8) The vehicle is not in IG ON state during calibration.   
(9)Absorbing materials are not placed as required.

General repair instructions

When checking the HUD, it may affect the airbag work. Therefore, before carrying out maintenance work, be sure to carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag.   
When the part needs to be replaced or the connector needs to be disconnected during maintenance of HUD, disconnect the battery negative cable.   
( The door control system needs to be initialized after reconnecting the battery. And use the HQVDS to "clear the DTC" for all electronic control systems.

### Function overview
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_d1ea798f` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:4899 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aThe information display system/instrument cluster is mainly used to provide vehicle state and driving information to the driver in a visual and/or audible manner.

The display includes power, vehicle speed, gear position information, alarm/indicator lamp, average vehicle speed, tire pressure information, time, various alarms and prompt information, etc.

Chinese display is supported in the instrument cluster display.

### 1. PA
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_82133e9a` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:4970 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a) The PA consists of control unit and ultrasonic sensor. The ultrasonic sensor can measure the distance between the vehicle and the obstacle. According to the distance of the obstacle entering the detection area, the speaker will sound at different frequencies. At the same time, the multimedia display will display the distance and orientation information of the obstacle. When using the system, be sure to pay attention to the surrounding area.

### Precautions for AVM
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_f138343a` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:5145 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aThe system cannot achieve absolute interference immunity due to the influence of various external sound fields and electromagnetic fields determined by physical characteristics (for example: other vehicle using ultrasonic distance measurement, air pressure, engine noise, electronically controlled gears, induction coil, etc.)

(The immunity from interference and the detection performance of the ultrasonic ranging system may reduce due to environmental conditions and obstacle reflection characteristics, which are determined by the physical properties of ultrasonic propagation.

(The installation position of the probe has an important impact on the performance of the system, which is reflected in the reflection of the vehicle bumper surface itself, the reflection of the ground echo, and the detection range.

( The propagation of sound waves in air is based on the physical properties of refraction and diffraction. The air temperature difference is one of the most important factors for the generation of non-uniform transmission media, which in turn leads to acoustic wave diffraction.

(e The detection performance of ultrasonic detection equipment is affected by the following factors:

( Hot automobile exhaust.   
(High temperature asphalt pavement.   
Summer breeze.   
(4Temperature stratification.

(f) When there is a difference between the bumper temperature and the ambient air temperature (which usually occurs in winter), temperature stratification will occur, which will lead to acoustic wave diffraction, and there is a risk of false alarm due to reflected echo under certain bumper structures.

(Significant factors that may lead to reduced or no detection range:

Snow or sludge is adhered to the bumper surface.

Plaster or ice is adhered to the sensor surface.   
(3) High acoustic attenuation (e. g., in a dry, high temperature environment).   
(4) In heavy rain or foam.   
(5) Obstacles with absorbing materials.   
(6) The edges and corners of flat obstacles are facing the sensor, and the reflected echo only occurs within a specific angle range.   
(hIf the camera becomes dirty, a clear image cannot be transmitted. Rinse with water and wipe clean with a soft cloth. If the camera is very dirty, clean it with neutral detergent and wipe it off.   
(i) When the system temperature is low, the displayed image may become dark and the moving image may be slightly distorted.

### Calibration environmental requirements
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_747ac3fe` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:5181 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/6567022f5a38a838d6de68bf9f5eb38acafbe1e95207ec4956719e4433b04768.webp)

1.The detailed dimensions of the calibration site are shown in the figure above: Caution: Calibration site size: width ≥ 5.5 m, length ≥ 9.3 m.

Site requirements

Wide and clean flat ground capable of meeting vehicle entry and calibration cloth laying;

3. Ground flatness and calibration cloth laying requirements

(a In order to ensure the calibration effect, the calibration site needs to be a flat ground as much as possible, and the calibration cloth will not have obvious unevenness after laying;   
The calibration cloth shall be laid with care to be fully opened and flat, and each piece shall correspond to the requirements.   
In order to ensure the calibration effect, the flatness of the ground after laying is required to be high, and the flatness error is required to be within +/-5 mm at any two-meter length.   
(dIt is recommended to use black-and-white epoxy floor paint for the drawing of calibration site, which involves wear resistance and matte performance. Better matte paint specifications can be selected according to the actual situation to achieve better wear resistance requirements.

### Requirements for placing body positioning device
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_c9d36a7f` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:5182 | doc_type:owners_manual
aThe wheel clamp and guide rail are preset on the site to ensure the parking accuracy. The guide rail is designed to the inside of the tire. The wheel clamp is designed along the tire direction as much as possible to avoid covering calibration elements on both sides.

### Lighting conditions
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_ddb74754` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:5183 | doc_type:owners_manual
The ambient light of the calibration site shall be mainly diffuse light, and the light source shall preferably be LED.

Walls around the site are recommended to be white and free of other equipment to ensure that the automatic calibration site is not disturbed by surrounding scenes or light sources. In order to prevent sunlight from entering the calibration site through the doors and windows, it is required that the doors and windows around the site shall be pasted with thickened white cloths or light shields. The calibration pattern captured by the surround view camera shall be free of reflection.

### 6Preservation of calibration cloth after calibration
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_0ad24473` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:5184 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aThe calibration cloth shall be rolled flat after use and properly preserved.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_fb5eca33` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:5185 | doc_type:owners_manual
If the calibration cloth is soaked in water, please dry it and then rollit up for storage to avoid wrinkles during rolling that will affect subsequent use.

`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_36593385` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:5186 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aMark the centers of the front and rear of the vehicle with a plumb.   
Pass the laser level gauge straight through the marked parts in the front and rear.   
Adjust the centerline of the front and rear calibration cloth to align with the laser level gauge line.

### Notice:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_a9adea19` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:5199 | doc_type:owners_manual
Always install the CANL bus and CANH bus together.   
When installing, make sure to strand them together.   
If the CAN bus is not twisted together, they are more vulnerable to electrical noise interference.

XBpas ams CA04160RM (Do not use bypass harness between connectors.

Notice: If a bypass harness is used, the twisted bus will lose its immunity to interference.

(During service operations, do not use wires to short CANH or CAN-L wires between the two connectors, which will affect bus transmission energy.

### System description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_500566a5` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:5205 | doc_type:owners_manual
1. The vehicle is equipped with a number of modern high-tech electronic control systems, the communication between each system is managed by the GW, and the LAN control can realize the data exchange and communication function of each electronic control system. The system has good data communication capability and self-diagnosis function.   
2. The vehicle network system consists of CAN subnet, LIN subnet and on-board ethernet.   
3. CAN combines CAN-H and CAN-L into one pair, and implements communication function under differential voltage to ensure high-speed communication.

### Check
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_0a01a87b` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:5583 | doc_type:owners_manual
1. Before front wheel alignment adjustment, the following check and overhaul shall be carried out to ensure the correctness of the positioning sampling value and positioning adjustment method.

Hint:

Only use a Hongqi approved wheel aligner for wheel alignment.

For adjustments, values shall be as accurate as possible to conform to relevant specifications.

(aThe car must be cooled.

(b) Check the wheel suspension, steering system and steering linkage for unacceptable gap and damage, and repair them if necessary.   
(c) The tire inflation pressure complies with the regulations.   
(d) Correctly calibrate the vehicle, repeatedly bouncing and shaking.   
(e) For a vehicle running on the axle measuring platform in a tension-free state, it is necessary to pass multiple vehicle front-loading and reset to make the axle parts stress-free.   
(f) In order to return the steering system to the middle position before starting the input measurement and the adjustment work, stop the steering wheel by balanced movement (using special tools)   
(g) The vehicle with coil spring suspension is in the no-load position which means: the weight of the vehicle ready for operation (fuel tank and washer fluid reservoir filled, spare wheel, driver's tools, jack), excluding the driver.   
(h) The measuring value receiver shall be installed and calibrated as required, and the operating instructions of the locator manufacturer must be followed.   
(i) Rim run-out compensation: due to the allowable axial run-out of the rim, the toe-in tolerance may be exceeded. Therefore, if the rim is not offset compensated, the toe-in adjustment cannot be performed correctly.   
(j) The axle test stand and the wheel aligner computer will deviate from their original calibration/ settings after a certain period of time, so they must be calibrated at least once a year within the maintenance range.   
(kThe tire inflation pressure complies with the regulations.

Damage caused by an accident.

### Notice:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_557e5f25` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:5823 | doc_type:owners_manual
Do not press the terminal with your fingers.

Do not pry the smart key battery forcibly, otherwise the terminal may be damaged.   
Do not touch the smart key battery with wet hands, otherwise water may cause rust.   
Do not touch or move any part in the smart key housing; otherwise it may interfere with normal operation.   
When replacing the smart key battery, remove the static electricity on the body by touching the vehicle before starting the operation to prevent the electronic transmitter housing from being damaged.

This manual is Hongqi NEW H5 Repair Manual. The chapters of the manual are shown in bold in the table of contents. Find the desired chapter according to the table of contents.

This manual is applicable to the vehicles listed below. The contents of this repair manual include general repair procedures for Hongqi NEW H5 in July 2022.

### Note
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_1d9b7cce` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:3 | doc_type:owners_manual
This manual does not cover all items required for vehicle repair and maintenance. This manual is intended for use by skilled and qualified personnel. If unprofessional or unqualified technicians only refer to this manual or do not use appropriate equipment or tools when making repairs or maintenance, it may cause injury to themselves or people around them and damage to customers' vehicles.

In order to prevent dangerous operation and avoid damage to the customer's vehicle, please observe the following regulations.

-The contents of this manual must be read thoroughly. In particular, fully understand allthe contents of the "Precautions" in the "Introduction" section The repair methods provided in this manual are very effective for vehicle repair. The specified or recommended tools must be used when following the procedures in this manual for maintenance operations. If tools and repair methods not specified or recommended are used, ensure the safety of the repair technician before starting the operation and ensure that no personal injury or customer vehicle damage will occur. If replacement is required, replace with a part with the same part number or an equivalent. Do not use inferior parts. If automatic configuration is required for replacing the electronic control module, the automatic configuration procedures are as follows: 1. Set the ignition switch to OFF position. 2. Connect the HQ-VDS to the DLC2. 3. Set the ignition switch to ON position. 4. Turn on the HQ-VDS. 5. Enter the following menus: System Scan/Module Programming/Auto Configuration/(select the module for Auto Configuration) 6. Perform the Auto Configuration according to HQ-VDS prompts. It must be noted that in order to effectively avoid possible personal injury during repair or maintenance, as wel as hidden dangers such as vehicle damage or vehicle insecurity due to improper operation, items like "Warning", "Caution", "Note" and "Tip" in this manual must be carefully observed. It shall also be noted that the "Warning", "Caution", "Note" and "Tip" sections of this manual are not exaggerated. Violations of these instructions may lead to dangerous consequences. 1. WARNiNG: It indicates a dangerous situation, which if not noticed, may cause serious injuries and even death. 2. Caution: it indicates a dangerous situation which, if you do not pay attention, may cause minor or moderate injuries. 3. Note: it indicates that if you do not pay attention, the vehicle may be damaged. 4. Tip: Tips and useful information for some precautions in the operation steps.

### Electrical fire rescue
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_b2a628ea` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:18 | doc_type:owners_manual
Alert the fire department.

(Confirm the type of fire.

When thoroughly inspecting the fire, do not contact any high-voltage parts, and always use insulating tools for inspection.   
Fire not caused by battery. •If there is a small fire and the flame does not spread to the high-voltage battery, a carbon dioxide or ABC dry powder extinguisher can be used to extinguish the fire.   
(Fire caused by battery. •If a high-voltage battery bends or is broken in a fire, or if a problem with the battery is suspected, a large amount of water shall be used to extinguish the fire.   
It may take 24 hours to completely extinguish battery fire. With thermal imaging camera, it can be confirmed whether the high voltage battery is completely cooled. If there is no thermal imaging camera, it is necessary to monitor whether the battery will reignite. Smoke indicates that the battery is still hot. Even if there is no smoke, it should be monitored for at least another hour.   
To avoid potential battery reburn, it is recommended to place the battery in an open area.

(Safety precautions for electric shock.

Always assume that all high voltage components are powered on!   
To avoid electric shock, do not directly touch any part of the vehicle, and always use insulating tools.   
(Cutting, crushing, or contacting high-voltage elements may cause serious electric shock or short circuit accidents.

(Other safety precautions.

(1 If the battery is on fire and releases toxic gas, irrelevant personnel must be evacuated.   
(2) Have self-protection consciousness, wear protective equipment, and do not inhale toxic smoke.   
(The inflation bottle, gas column and other components that store gas can reach the extreme temperature of steam explosion caused by expansion of boiling liquid. Before the "hot zone" of the accident is checked, disassemble these components with appropriate fine protection.   
(4Do not use carbon dioxide fire extinguisher to put out the fire on persons, which may cause a risk of suffocation.

The high voltage system may have high voltage. Do not touch the high voltage component with bare hands.

The high-voltage capacitors in high-voltage components such as MCU and DC/DC retain some electrical energy after the high voltage system is powered off. The residual electrical energy will be reduced to below 60 VDC within 2 minutes and will be completely released within 5 minutes.

After unlocking the service switch, placing the ignition switch in the START (READY) position may cause a malfunction.

(aSet the ignition switch to OFF position.   
Disconnect the negative terminal of the low-voltage battery.   
(c) Check the insulating gloves model and confirm that its rated voltage exceeds 500 VAC/700 VDC; Make sure that the insulating gloves are dry and free of dirt and air leakage. Put the sleeves in the gloves when wearing.   
(Unlock the low voltage service switch and lock the service switch with a safety lock to avoid the risk of electric shock caused by misoperation of others.   
(e Wait for 5 minutes, and wait for the end of the capacitor discharge in the high-voltage loop.   
(f) Use insulating devices such as insulating tape to protect the exposed high-voltage live parts in all directions to ensure that the high-voltage live parts cannot be directly contacted.

Safe operation steps for restoring high-voltage loop

(aCheck the insulating gloves model and confirm that its rated voltage exceeds 500 VAC/700 VDC; Make sure that the insulating gloves are dry and free of dirt and air leakage. Put the sleeves in the gloves when wearing.   
(bRemove insulating devices such as insulating tape.   
(Connect the low voltage service switch.   
(dConnect battery -.   
(eSet the ignition switch to START and make the instrument cluster display the Ready state.

Confirm that the micro-ohmmeter has been verified before check. Confirm that the insulating gloves have been verified and are dry and free of air leakage. ### DC system insulation resistance check (except traction battery)
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_e9b1abfc` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:30 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aInspection tools

Operation steps

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_5511e432` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:31 | doc_type:owners_manual
Confirm that the insulation meter has been verified; Check whether the probe of the insulation meter and the test lead are in good condition; Check that the actual test voltage output from the insulation meter in 500 V test voltage gear is not lower than DC 495 V. Check that the insulating gloves have been verified; Check that the insulating gloves are dry and free of air leakage. Confirm that the battery negative harness and low voltage service switch are disconnected. The high-voltage harness of each high-voltage assembly is connected before measurement.

Wear insulating gloves.   
Set the insulation meter test voltage to DC 500 V.   
(3) Measure the insulation resistance between the positive and negative poles of the vehicle DC bus, motor, A/C and DCDC battery terminals and the electric platform respectively, and record them.   
(4) Remove the high-voltage connector at the DC bus battery terminal and test by contacting the red probe of the insulation meter with the positive terminal of the connector; Then contact the red probe of insulation meter with the connector negative terminal and the insulation meter negative with the body ground for the test. Be careful not to contact the probe with the internal shielding structure of the connector during the measurement. After the test is completed, insert the connector properly to ensure that the locking mechanism is locked.   
(5) Remove the high-voltage connector at the DC bus DCDC terminal, and test by contacting the red probe of the insulation meter with the positive terminal of the connector and contacting the negative terminal of the insulation meter with the body ground; Then contact the red probe of insulation meter with the connector negative terminal and the insulation meter negative with the body ground for the test. Be careful not to contact the probe with the internal shielding structure of the connector during the measurement.

(6If the insulation resistance is less than 500 M, it does not meet the requirements (the detection value is generally greater than 2.5 MΩ, and the detection value of the electric drive system is generally greater than 1 MQ), and it shall be returned to the maintenance area for treatment.

![](images/54e2d3e00f2b45db100087f446b487f5587d1a4de5bb0c6da814458098c76ec4.webp)

Do not disassemble the ECU. (If the terminal of the integrated circuit is touched, the integrated circuit may be damaged due to static electricity.)   
(Do not subject electronic parts such as ECUs, sensors, and relays to impact. If it falls, renew it.   
(The electronic parts shall avoid the influence of high temperature and high humidity environment.   
(4When cleaning the engine compartment with steam, be careful not to let the water directly stick to the electronic parts, air cleaner and other related parts.   
Do not touch the terminal of the connector to prevent deformation and static electricity, causing adverse conditions.   
(6Never use impact wrench to remove and install temperature sensor.

### 1 Handling of hose clamp
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_6d6068ca` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:34 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/474755b3ad34e929ed288514e217912ffef2f91780d6dec472727a17be750a39.webp)

![](images/7c435957c158d279e8396e24a056e1093c4f55ababd91f9806a9175019457d8f.webp)

(aBefore removing the hose, confirm the insertion depth and clamp position of the hose so that it can be reset.   
(If the clamp is deformed or weakened in elasticity, replace it with a new one.   
(When reusing the hose, install the clamp according to the clamp marks of the hose.   
(After installing the clamp, close the clamp in the direction shown by the arrow in the figure.

12.Installation of mobile communication equipment

(aBe sure to install it away from vehicle electronics such as ECUs, sensors, etc.   
Relevant accessories shall be installed correctly in accordance with each installation instruction.   
(Do not install high-power mobile communication equipment.

![](images/287be13a949ba80bae806ccf8e31ebf964145eb3a8430996a14831e2aba73c87.webp)

### 13.Inspection and maintenance of headlamp
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_b74e401f` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:35 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aDo not touch the high voltage socket when the headlamp lights up.   
When the headlamp is on, do not cover the headlamp for more than 3 minutes. Hint: Headlamp operation precautions shall be strictly observed during inspection and maintenance. The external lens of the headlamp is made of resin, so long-term operation will deform it due to overheating.

### Precautions for the vehicle state during vehicle lifting
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_52ed0bba` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:36 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aBased on the principle that the vehicle is close to no-load state, do not jack and lift the vehicle when it is loaded with heavy objects.   
If heavy parts such as engine and transmission are removed, the center of gravity of the vehicle will move. Therefore, it is necessary to balance the load and not to tilt it.

![](images/1e0d4954dde4fb5d122cca7feee149b70da37eb2c1c50f8241651be2dd0140c1.webp)

…Position of center of gravity of veile (under no load

IN05050RM

### Precautions for using jack and bracket
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_353becec` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:37 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/d4a0dea056424097b0bc785c56785f341926c3403fb0332e9f5e7c421facebd0.webp)

Be sure to use stop block when working on flat ground.   
(bUse bracket with rubber accessories.   
(c) Support the jack and bracket in the correct positions.   
(d) When jacking up the front wheels, release the parking brake and place stop blocks only on the rear side of the rear wheels. When jacking up the rear wheels, place the stop blocks only in front of the front wheels.   
(eWhen only jacking up the front or rear wheels, place stop blocks on the front and rear sides of the ground wheel.

Hint:

Do not work or park when only the jack supports the vehicle. Be sure to use the bracket support.

(f) When the jack is lowered from the state that only the front wheels are jacked up, the parking brake shall be released, and stop blocks shall be placed on the front and rear sides of the rear wheels. When only jacking up the rear wheels and lowering the jack, the stop block shall be placed on the front and rear sides of the front wheels.

Hint: Do not use wheeled jack at oil sump.

### Precautions for using plate lift
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_efec4d9f` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:38 | doc_type:owners_manual
Follow the operating instructions of the lift for safe operation.

Hint:

If the standard plate size is not used or the lift support is improperly positioned and greatly deviated from the center of gravity of the vehicle, the stability of the vehicle will be significantly reduced and the body may be damaged.

![](images/1e0803c824992155466d91c3e528f5c058c0070e1723894dd289845ba8075f34.webp)

IN00210RM

When lifting the vehicle with a platform lift it shall be confirmed that the center of gravity of the vehicle is within the allowable range of the vehicle center of gravity of the lift.

![](images/2a1b44165025f18f6d86d51ba695687e164cc5805500efef39aede04b8cb7a21.webp)  
Lift cylinder center

IN00220RM

Hint:

If the center of gravity of the vehicle deviates from the allowable range of the vehicle center of gravity position of the lift, the vehicle will sway during lifting and lowering. If you do not know the allowable range of the centre of gravity position of the vehicle, please consult the respective lift manufacturer.

The vehicle must be in the designated location.

(Lift the vehicle and shake it to confirm that it is stable.

Platform lift

![](images/170973fc8994928ff9cc2057e4ebd942db060096f250544cf14602646c81aaed.webp)  
Precautions for using rocker arm lift

IN05070RM

Rocker arm lift

![](images/2f56fcb491d91b4ddbbba716f6f6737c33a4f76300c0dab4f824252d931fdc1a.webp)

IN05080RM

Follow the operating instructions of the lift for safe operation.   
Use bracket with rubber accessories.   
(cThe vehicle should be parked such that the center of the lift is close to the center of gravity of vehicle.   
When the vehicle is horizontal, adjust the height of the support part to ensure no collision with the sill molding.   
(eThe rocker arm must be locked during operation.   
(f) Lift the tire and shake the vehicle slightly to confirm whether the vehicle is stable.

Precautions for using 4-post lift and wheel lift

Follow the operating instructions of the lift for safe operation.   
Do not damage the tires and wheels with the free wheel skeleton.   
(Fix the vehicle with a stop block.

### Basic inspection
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_18cdbeed` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:39 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/643fc0d54d08cd9e4fee72d3913d86b25b030272cdc41105dd2866047199df4a.webp)

(aResistance measurement conditions for electronic parts.

( Unless otherwise specified, all resistance measurements shall be made at an outside temperature of 20°C. If it is measured immediately after vehicle driving (high temperature), the resistance will exceed the specified value, so it should be measured after the engine has cooled down.

Operation of the connector.

(When disconnecting the connector with lock, push the connector fitting part to easily move the claw of the lock and then detach the lock.   
When disconnecting the connector, do not pull the harness, and directly hold the connector to disconnect it.   
(Before connecting the connector, check the connector terminal for deformation, damage and falling off.   
(4When connecting the connector with lock, insert it firmly until the locking sound is heard.   
(When checking the connector with digital multimeter, use a micro probe to check from the back (harness side).

### Notice:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_b173bae7` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:40 | doc_type:owners_manual
Do not check the waterproof connector from the back, so check it by connecting auxiliary wires. Do not move the inserted probe at will to prevent damage to the terminal.

(Connector check methods.

![](images/4c5d3e6dbb12de8b900198c23892010dab033980eb34de7dc55096946d85ee11.webp)

( When connecting the connector, hold the connector housing to check whether it is fully inserted and locked. (Fitted state)   
When the connector is disconnected, gently pull the harness for checking (terminal falling off, terminal loose hemming, disconnected core wire). Visually check it for rust, metal chips, water or foreign matter and check the terminals for bending, corrosion or deformation.   
(Prepare a terminal identical to the plug terminal, insert it into the socket terminal, and check the fitting and sliding fit to confirm that the terminal contact pressure is appropriate.

![](images/deefde041caa6d5756016c2de6bf21e5d2b28c11881e632bddde29d13480413b.webp)

(dRepair methods for connector terminal.

If there is dirt on the contact point, use the blower gun, rags, etc. to clear it. At this time, do not polish with sandpaper, etc. to prevent damage to the plating layer on the contact point surface.   
(2) Replace the socket terminal when the contact pressure is abnormal. If the plug terminal is gold-plated (in gold color), use goldplated socket terminal; If tinned (in silver color), use tinned socket terminal.   
(When there is no abnormality in the contact point, clean the contact point with a blower gun and apply connector grease (this method can prevent the contact point from oxidation and wear).

(eConnector grease.

![](images/c65256e97dd34b86c6d24f9fce40d7eef79e5e3e24a8dc72ec4dd8cbbb8c40c6.webp)

(Apply grease (white) that can prevent terminal from corrosion on the connectors that are easy to get wet, such as connectors of AC alternator and headlamps.   
When the grease on the connector is insufficient or the terminal is being repaired, connector grease should be applied to the socket terminal by hand.

Hint:

Do not get dust.   
Do not apply with tools such as screwdriver.

( If grease is applied to the rubber parts (except the O-ring and rubber plug of waterproof connector), it will make them aged and discolored. If this occurs, it should be wiped off immediately.

![](images/21ae70cc90a341d76d12336d31807b6c3b8c35eb0381e4a1f5ce638e2ea4f96b.webp)

Operation of the harness.

(When removing the harness, check the wiring and clamping conditions before working so that it can be restored to its original state.   
If not necessary, do not twist or stretch the harness.   
(3)Do not rotate, slide and vibrate the harness, and keep it away from high-temperature parts and parts with sharp corners (plate ends, screw tips, etc.).   
(4Do not squeeze the harness when installing parts.   
Do not damage the harness cladding. If it is damaged, replace it with a new one or wrap it with vinyl tape.

### Check open circuit
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_37cb141f` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:41 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/4345539aa886854d1f6b0b4e2b845a270b2b25dd87c6d900c3c7119701b9af3c.webp)

(aAs shown in the figure, when harness is open, carry out continuity or voltage inspection to locate the open circuit.

Check continuity.

![](images/1e4c3f594f61ac9c9258e8dd31dda0824b4a74b9700713c0c1bd117832afebc3.webp)

(Disconnect the connectors A and C and measure the resistance between them.

### Standard value: below 1 Ω
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_cd8ecfb4` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:42 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

Gently shake the harness up and down, left

and right and measure the resistance.   
As shown in the figure, there is no continuity (open circuit) between terminal 1 of connector A and terminal 1 of connector C, and there is continuity between terminal 2 of connector A and terminal 2 of connector C. At this time, there is open circuit between terminal 1 of connector A and terminal 1 of connector C.   
Disconnect the connector B and measure the resistance between connectors.   
(4As shown in the figure, there is continuity between terminal 1 of connector A and terminal 1 of connector B1, and there is no continuity (open circuit) between terminal 1 of connector B2 and terminal 1 of connector C. At this time, there is open circuit between terminal 1 of connector B2 and terminal 1 of connector C.

![](images/6c7063d16bf471b45703cfb4f9c161099df427346828f250fc6169fbc9019302.webp)

(Check voltage.

(In the circuit with voltage applied to the ECU connector terminal, the open circuit can be determined by voltage check.   
(As shown in the figure, each connector is connected, and the ECU 5 V output terminal is used to measure the voltage between the body ground and the terminal 1 of connector A, and then the voltage between the terminal 1 of connector B and the terminal 1 of connector C.   
(3) The harness between terminal 1 of connector B and terminal 1 of connector C is opencircuited when the following conditions are met.

### Standard value:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_7b89377a` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:43 | doc_type:owners_manual
5V voltage between terminal 1 of connector A and body ground

5V voltage between terminal 1 of connector B and body ground

### Check for short circuit
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_187b2584` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:44 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/f3b38f2485ec7aef535113a258ce372d3a981fcac9b4a7807ce3df7b929cb504.webp)

As shown in the figure, when the harness ground is short circuited, carry out the ground continuity inspection to locate the short circuit.

![](images/6093ebbbcd8d18edb2cb32e14449d188c0d0cf0c2f33133bb95169475560f88d.webp)

Continuity check of the ground.

(1 Disconnect the connectors A and C, and measure the resistance between terminals 1 and 2 of connector A and body ground.

### Standard value: above 10 kΩ
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_a020e99c` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:45 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

Gently shake the harness up and down, left and right and measure the resistance.

(As shown in the figure, there is the continuity (short circuit) between terminal 1 of connector A and body ground, and there is no continuity between terminal 2 of connector A and body ground. At this time, there is short circuit between the terminal 1 of connector A and the terminal 1 of connector C.

![](images/9e7f2112a86c38fd7a9d5e9ff45a7ebb5cd9bc26dc57787847a79cc64e54fe2d.webp)

(Disconnect connector B, and measure the resistance between terminal 1 of connector A and body ground, and between terminal 1 of connector B2 and body ground. If there is no continuity between the terminal 1 of connector A and the body ground, and there is continuity between the terminal 1 of B2 and the body ground (short circuit), it indicates that the circuit between the terminal 1 of connector B2 and the terminal 1 of connector C is shorted.

Visual inspection and contact pressure check

![](images/9034404494f3af2c36a8aa34f31564687972807fe81607ca27556842b6cd9b58.webp)

(aDisconnect the connectors at both ends.   
Check whether there is rust and foreign matter on the connector terminal.   
(Confirm whether the crimped part is loose or damaged, and check whether the terminal is firmly fixed in the locking position.   
(dPrepare a plug terminal, insert it into the socket terminal and then pull it out. Hint: If the test terminal can be pulled out easily compared with other terminals, the contact is poor.

### Check and replace ECU
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_b2ab1e96` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:46 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/d99f72ecfc03ece477752c68271c80ff79a78cbfe0ea6f4557c6eb51713c7657.webp)

Hint:

•With the connector and ECU connected, check from the back of the harness connector.   
If no measuring condition is specified, carry out inspection when the engine is stopped and the ignition switch is turned off.   
(First check the ECU ground circuit, and repair it if there is a fault. If it is normal, the ECU may be faulty. Replace it with a normal ECU, and then check whether the fault symptoms are eliminated. (Measure the resistance between the ground terminal of the ECU and the body ground. Standard value: below 1 Ω (2) Disconnect the ECU connector, confirm that the ground terminals of the ECU and the harness are not bent, and check the contact pressure.

### General repair instructions
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_985f787e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:50 | doc_type:owners_manual
Only the use of digital multimeter to check EFI system is permitted.   
(Genuine part shall be used during maintenance, otherwise the normal operation of the EFI system cannot be guaranteed.   
( Only unleaded gasoline can be used during maintenance.   
(Please follow the standard maintenance and diagnosis process for maintenance work.   
(e It is forbidden to disassemble and remove the parts of EFI system during maintenance.   
(f) During maintenance, take and place electronic components (ECU, sensor, etc.) carefully to avoid injuries caused by impact and static electricity.   
(Establish awareness of environmental protection and effectively dispose of wastes generated during maintenance.

### Maintenance precautions
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_a8ac373f` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:51 | doc_type:owners_manual
Do not remove any part of the EFI system or its connector from its installation position at will, so as to avoid accidental damage or foreign matters such as water and oil entering the connector and affecting the normal operation of the EFI system.   
When disconnecting or connecting each part connector, be sure to set the ignition switch in off position. Otherwise the electrical components will be damaged.   
(Never make the temperature of the ECU exceed 80°C during hot working conditions simulation of faults and other maintenance operations that may increase the temperature.   
(d) The oil supply pressure of the EFl system is relatively high, so the fuel pipeline adopts high pressure resistant fuel pipe. High fuel pressure is maintained in the fuel circuit even if the engine is not running. Therefore, be careful not to remove the oil pipe easily during maintenance. If the fuel system needs to be repaired, depressurize the fuel system before removing the fuel pipe.   
(e When removing the electric fuel pump from the fuel tank, do not energize the pump to avoid electric sparks and fire.   
(f) Do not run the fuel pump in dry state or in water for test; otherwise its service life will be shortened. In addition, do not reverse the positive and negative poles of the fuel pump.   
( When checking the ignition system, the sparkover detection can only be carried out when necessary, and the time should be as short as possible. During the spark-over detection, the fuel injector connector should be disconnected to make the fuel injector not work, so as to avoid a large amount of unburned gasoline entering the exhaust manifold and damaging the TWC.   
(hSince the idle speed control is completed by the EFI system, no manual control is required. The corresponding self-learning has been performed by the electronic throttle body when the system is powered on for the first time, so the disassembling and commissioning of the electronic throttle body are not allowed.   
(i) Correctly connect the positive and negative poles of the battery to avoid damage to the electronic component. This system adopts negative ground.   
(j) When the engine is running, removal of battery cable is not allowed.   
(kBefore carrying out electric welding on the vehicle, in order to protect the safety of EFI system, disconnect the battery positive and negative cables, and remove the ECU at the same time.   
(1) It is not recommended to use the method of piercing the wire skin to detect the electrical signal input and output of the part, so as to avoid harness short circuit.

### 1. EMS
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_a09913a3` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:57 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a The EMS is usually composed of sensors, microprocessors (ECUs) and actuators to control the intake air volume, fuel injection volume and ignition advance angle when the engine is working.

The system adopts a combination of open-loop and closed-loop (feedback) control to provide various control signals for the operation of the engine. The basic functions of the system include: start control, heating control of warm-up and TWC, acceleration/deceleration and reverse towing fuel cutoff control, idle speed control, closed-loop control, mixture control, evaporative emission control, knock control and OBD diagnostic control, etc. In addition, additional functions include engine immobilizer, start-stop control, fan control, A/C control, VVT control, turbocharging control, etc.

### Start control
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_b5fa5e4e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:58 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a During the starting process, special calculation methods shall be adopted to control the charge, fuel injection and ignition timing. At the beginning of this process, air in the intake manifold is stationary, and the internal pressure of the intake manifold is indicated as the ambient atmospheric pressure. The electronic throttle is set to a fixed opening parameter based on the starting temperature at that time. The fuel injection mode and injection volume vary according to the temperature of the engine to promote better mixture of the fuel and air in the cylinder. In order to obtain reliable combustible mixture near the spark plug, the mixture should be enriched before the engine reaches a certain speed. Once the engine starts to run, the system starts to gradually reduce the fuel injection amount until the start enrichment is completely canceled at the end of start working condition. Under the starting condition, the ignition angle is also constantly adjusted. It varies with engine temperature, intake air temperature and engine speed. High-voltage start is usually used. In case of failure mode or extremely low temperature, low pressure start is adopted.

Heating control of warm up and TWC The engine still needs additional supply of fuel for a period of time after starting at low temperature. Multiple injections may be carried out according to the working conditions, and the cylinder charge and ignition angle are adjusted to compensate for the higher torque requirements of the engine; This process continues until the appropriate temperature threshold is reached. The most important aspect of this phase is the rapid heating of TWC, because a rapid transition to TWC operation can greatly reduce exhaust emissions. Under this working conditions, the exhaust gas is used for "TWC heating" with appropriate fuel injection mode (multiple injections) and a moderately delayed ignition advance angle.

### 4Acceleration / deceleration and reverse towing fuel cutoff control
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_4db92083` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:59 | doc_type:owners_manual
(In fact, a small part of the fuel injected into the cylinder will not participate in the combustion process in time. Instead, it forms an film on the cylinder wall or piston. When the throttle opening increases, a small part of the injected fuel is absorbed by the film. Therefore, the corresponding amount of supplementary fuel must be injected for compensation and prevent the mixture from thinning during acceleration.Once the load factor is reduced, the additional fuel contained in the fuel film will be released again, and the corresponding injection duration must be reduced during deceleration. Reverse towing or traction condition means the case where the power provided by the engine at the flywheel is negative. In this case, the friction and pumping losses of the engine can be used to decelerate the vehicle. When the engine is in reverse towing or traction conditions, the fuel injection is cut off to reduce fuel consumption and exhaust emissions, and more importantly, to protect the TWC. Once the speed drops to the recovery speed set above idle speed, the fuel injection system will supply fuel again. In fact, there is a recovery speed range in the ECU program, which varies according to the changes of engine temperature, gear position, dynamic change of engine speed and other parameters, and the speed is prevented from falling to the specified minimum threshold through calculation. Once the injection system is re-fueled, the system begins to supply make-up fuel using the initial injection pulse. After fuel injection is resumed, the torque-based control system makes the increase of engine torque slow and smooth (gentle transition).

### Idle speed control
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_93d0717e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:60 | doc_type:owners_manual
When idling, the engine does not provide torque to the flywheel. In order to ensure the stable operation of the engine at the lowest idle speed as possible, the closed-loop idle speed control system must maintain the balance between the torque generated and the "power consumption" of the engine. When idling, a certain amount of power needs to be generated to meet various load requirements, They include internal friction from engine crankshaft and valve train as well as auxiliary components such as coolant pump. The system uses the torque as the main control strategy to determine the engine output torque required to maintain the required idle speed under any working conditions based on the closed-loop idle speed control. The output torque increases with the decrease in the engine speed and decreases with the increase in the engine speed. The system responds to new "interference factors" by requiring bigger torque, such as the starting up and turning off of the A/C compressor or the gear shift of the automatic transmission. When the engine temperature is low, the torque also needs to be increased in order to compensate greater internal friction loss and/or maintain higher idle speed. The sum of all these output torque requirements is transmitted to the torque coordinator, which performs processing and calculation and obtains the corresponding charge density, mixture composition and ignition timing.

Closed-loop control

aTWC exhaust aftertreatment is an effective method to reduce the concentration of harmful substances in exhaust gas. A three-way catalytic converter can reduce hydrocarbons (HC), carbon monoxide (CO) and nitrogen oxides (NOx) by 98% or more, converting them into water (H2O), carbon dioxide (CO2) and nitrogen (N2). However, such a high efficiency can only be achieved within a very narrow range around the engine excess air coefficient λ = 1, and the closed-loop control goal is to ensure that the mixture concentration is within this range. The closed-loop control system can only work when equipped with an oxygen sensor. Oxygen sensor monitors the oxygen content in the exhaust gas at a location on the TWC side, the lean mixture (λ > 1) produces a sensor voltage of about 100 mV and the rich mixture (λ < 1) produces a sensor voltage of about 800 mV. When λ=1, there is a jump in the sensor voltage. The closed-loop control modifies the control variable in response to the input signal (λ > 1 = lean mixture, λ< 1 = rich mixture) to generate a correction factor as a multiplier to correct the injection duration.

### 7Evaporative emission control
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_21c0b435` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:61 | doc_type:owners_manual
(The fuel in the fuel tank is heated to form fuel vapor due to external radiant heat and return heat transfer. As restricted by evaporative emission regulations, these vapors containing a large amount of HC components are prohibited from direct discharge into the atmosphere. In the system fuel vapors are collected in the activated carbon canister through the guide pipe and enter the engine by purging when appropriate to participate in the combustion process. The flow of purging air is realized by the ECU controlling the canister control valve. This control only works when the closed-loop control system works in a closed loop.

Knock control

(aThe system detects the characteristic vibration when the knock is generated through the knock sensor installed at the appropriate position of the engine, and converts it into an electronic signal for transmission to the ECU for processing. ECU uses a special processing algorithm to detect whether knock occurs in each combustion cycle of each cylinder. Once knock is detected, the closed-loop knock control is triggered. When the knock risk is eliminated, the ignition of the affected cylinder is gradually advanced again to the predetermined ignition advance angle.

### OBD fault diagnosis control
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_f3bf4367` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:62 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a The ECU continuously monitors the sensor, actuator, related circuit, fault indicator lamp and battery voltage, etc., as well as the ECU itself, and conducts rationality tests on sensor output signals, actuator drive signals and internal signals (such as lambda closed-loop control, coolant temperature, knock control, idle speed control and battery voltage control). Once a link is found to be faulty, or a signal value is implausible, the ECU immediately sets a fault information record in the fault memory of RAM. The fault information records are stored in the form of DTC and displayed in the order in which the faults occur.

### 10 TMM (smart thermal management module)
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_c2305e11` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:63 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aSmart thermal management module is a new type of engine thermal management system control strategy. Its core component is an electronic ball valve driven by a motor to control the coolant flow of multiple circuits. The main purpose of the smart thermal management module is to speed up the engine heating process by separately controlling the opening time of the cooling water circulation of cylinder head and cylinder block, and to more accurately control the engine temperature of the hot engine state, so as to achieve the goal of reducing vehicle fuel consumption. At the same time, the transmission fluid cooler is also included in the cooling system, which can effectively shorten the transmission fluid temperature rise process. Warm up working conditions: electronic ball valve closes the radiator cycle to speed up the temperature rise of the coolant; As the coolant temperature rises, the oil can be

heated in advance. It can shorten the warm up time, improve combustion, reduce friction, reduce cooling loss and reduce fuel consumption.Hot engine working conditions: electronic ball valve controls the coolant flowing through the radiator as required to achieve different cooling effects, and makes the engine operate in the economic water temperature zone as much as possible to reduce fuel consumption of the vehicle.

### Description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_6551b71e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:67 | doc_type:owners_manual
The VVT system adjusts the intake and exhaust valve timing to improve handling performance. ECM changes the oil passage through the solenoid valve, and use the oil pressure to turn the camshaft regulator to adjust the valve timing. When ECM applies 12 V voltage to the solenoid valve, the valve moves. ECM changes the excitation time (duty ratio) of the solenoid valve according to the camshaft position, crankshaft position, throttle position, etc.

### Description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_0a778852` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:77 | doc_type:owners_manual
The VVT system adjusts the intake and exhaust valve timing to improve handling performance. ECM changes the oil passage through the solenoid valve, and use the oil pressure to turn the camshaft regulator to adjust the valve timing. When ECM applies 12 V voltage to the solenoid valve, the valve moves. ECM changes the excitation time (duty ratio) of the solenoid valve according to the camshaft position, crankshaft position, throttle position, etc.

![](images/1908043516624bf0402c9fafd6229e8d4b8f567214b9c648eb17bd88567585bc.webp)

![](images/de355cbedfa136566416bcb3d230efae57532af70859ce4246372c403770c44f.webp)

### Description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_9c72760c` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:279 | doc_type:owners_manual
When the engine misfire occurs, unburned hydrocarbons enter the exhaust gas, which cause an increase in exhaust gas emissions and may also raise the temperature of the TWC, leading to the damage to the TWC. To avoid increased emissions and damage from high temperatures, the ECM will monitor the number of engine misfires. The ECM uses the camshaft position sensor and crankshaft position sensor to monitor the misfire situation. The camshaft position sensor is used to identify the cylinder that misfired, while the crankshaf position sensor position sensor is used to measure the change in crankshaft speed. When the change in crankshaft speed exceeds a predetermined threshold, the number of misfires will be counted. If the number of misfires exceeds the threshold and may cause deterioration of emission control system performance, ECM records DTC.

![](images/611c02a5c7e90a1fc54d95bfaf6f48d8d02303622b11b4ad57bb719b3ec0c87b.webp)

### Description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_b734450d` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:348 | doc_type:owners_manual
The ECM monitors the operation of the TWC by means of oxygen sensor signals. When the upstream and downstream oxygen sensors detec that there is no significant difference in the oxygen content in the exhaust gas, the ECM determines the aging of the TWC, and the engine control unit records the DTC.

### Description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_6a26a9da` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:592 | doc_type:owners_manual
The EMS corrects and conducts selflearning to the fuel injection quantity according to the deviation degree and characteristics of the air-fuel ratio. When the self-learning value exceeds the upper limit or lower limit value set by the system, the system will udge that the self-learning value is above upper limit or below lower limit, and ECM will record the DTC.

![](images/36663f967e15b1b795e108e9e168b3eb25a434fdc361d6260f80e94d1bf3bda8.webp)

### Inspection procedure
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_d676ee81` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:617 | doc_type:owners_manual

Set the ignition switch to "ON".   
(Check whether the ambient pressure sensor signal value is significantly different from the current atmospheric pressure.   
(Check whether the ambient pressure sensor signal value is too high or too low.   
(Record and clear the DTC.   
Check whether the DTC appears again.

### 10Crankshaft axial play and crankshaft rotation torque measurement

### 12Install piston ring
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_bcc91e82` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:760 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aWipe the piston ring groove clean, ensure no foreign body is in the ring groove, and install the rings in sequence.

`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_6ce98f1d` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:761 | doc_type:owners_manual
The side clearance between the upper compression ring and the groove is (0.03\~0.07) mm.

The side clearance between the middle compression ring and the groove is (0.02\~0.06) тm.

The side clearance between oil ring and groove is (0.04\~0.16) mm.

![](images/c1b96ee343317178ddb3743798d33b50b5e7ddbf43f2c5546cc35d2738db2aa9.webp)

(Adjust the opening position of each ring as shown in the figure.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_91e4dbed` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:762 | doc_type:owners_manual
Adjust the opening position of each ring to ensure that the gap between the upper compression ring opening and the middle compression ring opening is 180 °, the gap between the two scraper openings of the oil ring is more than 60 °, and the gap with the bushing ring opening is more than 30 °. The face of the upward mark of the piston ring must be upward, and the piston ring should be able to rotate flexibly after being installed in the groove.

### 1Grouping of connecting rod bearing shell
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_5bc344be` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:763 | doc_type:owners_manual
aThe connecting rod bearing shells are divided into 3 groups according to the wall thickness, and the group numbers are printed on the back of the bearing shells.
