15Install the piston and connecting rod assembly

![](images/ad152a0d6a51a731a02593e933c717412d479368586af6fdb737d3e753511c1b.webp)

Turn the crankshaft clockwise to make the first and fourth connecting rod journals in the TDC position, and install the crankshaft timing pin on the exhaust side of the front end of the cylinder block.

According to the connecting rod journal group mark and connecting rod big end hole group mark on the crankshaft, select the connecting rod bearing shell according to the assembly relationship table.

(Install the connecting rod upper bearing shell into the connecting rod bearing shell seat hole.

Hint:

During manual installation, it is necessary to align the bearing shell positioning lip with the groove, and make the shell back against the seat surface of the connecting rod big end hole.

No oil or other foreign matters are allowed between the back of the connecting rod bearing shell and the seat hole.

(dWipe the cylinder bore and spray oil mist around the cylinder bore wall with sprayer.

Hint:

Ensure that an appropriate amount of lubricating oil is applied to the whole circumference of the cylinder within 10 mm from the top surface.

Apply oil to the surface of the piston ring, piston skirt, and connecting rod bearing shell of the piston and connecting rod assembly.

(Check whether the split ring position is correct. Hint:

Ensure that the piston ring opening are staggered with each other, and follow the location distribution diagram of piston ring opening.

Push the piston and connecting rod assembly into the cylinder with a suitable tool.

Hint:

Ensure that the connecting rod and the piston cooling nozzle are not scratched during the pushing process.

![](images/076e0060a54c819ab8e2c435479d05dd00e1857de1bb8c8bf6c16c495ba79f2c.webp)

(After manually setting the connecting rod bolt, remove the crankshaft timing pin, install the connecting rod big end cap-Bwith the connecting rod lower bearing shell into the connecting rod-A, and tighten the bolt -1-2-.

Torque: 17 \~ 23NбН Turning angle 85 ° \~ 95 °

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_341e7f58` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:764 | doc_type:owners_manual
The forward mark on the connecting rod cover shall be on the same side as the mark on the connecting rod body.

(h)Turn the crankshaft so that each connecting rod journal is in the position of TDC and repeat the above steps,

Hint:

Place the engine horizontally with all pistons and connecting rods installed.

When rotating the crankshaft at a constant speed, the allowable range of rotation torque is: not more than 5 \~ 15 NбН.

The seizure phenomenon is not allowed in the rotation process.

Measure the gap between the crankshaft connecting rod journal and the connecting rod big end side, with a range of (0.15 to 0.35) mm.

(Install the balance shaft timing plug -1-.

1 Install the cylinder head

![](images/9acc2e99f076adf78cd6879648f18eaeae0a0f71976ad898754ea6a337116b4c.webp)

Wipe the bottom surface and front end surface of the cylinder head assembly -A-, and carefully place it onto the cylinder head gasket with the dowel pin hole aligned with the dowel pin on the cylinder block.

Insert the 10 cylinder head bolts into the cylinder head bolt holes. The tightening sequence is shown in the figure. Torque: 40 N б m +180 °

20Install the camshaft (a) Measure camshaft axial play: 0.09\~0.31 mm.

### 21 Install the valve chamber cover
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_37f72bc9` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:771 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/def769ba3b95e55904534004949e7055b3c3c376a4715b85f226c8ab0ad54700.webp)

(aInstall the intake and exhaust camshaft timing plugs -1-4and washers -5-8-.

![](images/665f0e45a9c35463c35f73404365ddac3b28a9320752306da92f7d2dec60ab95.webp)

Remove the crankshaft timing plug, rotate the crankshaft to a proper angle, screw SST (39GC110110C) into the timing hole of the cylinder block, and tighten it to lock the crankshaft to ensure that the crankshaft is at the TDC of 1# cylinder.

![](images/ea28f8f7ae73a88be3bcf54ffab419d7f073e022f932d897ab25b893a7120a1f.webp)

Install valve chamber cover gasket -A-.

![](images/a0a097b5ffa404bfdc698fa41b284a683b6d37c160148964f6e424c9900f75d0.webp)

![](images/d80eb29a2fd55104397bb6e9b9f95d7207edcac57d4e95f56fb11cde07f0182b.webp)

Finally, align the valve chamber cover with the dowel pin hole to install t on the cylinder head, and apply sealant onto the valve chamber cover and its local part.

(Install the fixing bolt -arrowof valve chamber cover -A-. Torque: 15 \~ 19 N б m

22.Install balance shaft chain and tensioner arm assembly

![](images/df17875609a50bbbe67ef62ed076892905a0056e5340296168b722f41cc320ff.webp)

(a Use the bolt -1to install the drive sprocket-Aand balance shaft brake lining-B-. Do not tighten the bolt -1temporarily. Final torque: 28 \~ 32 N б m

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_76e2e46e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:772 | doc_type:owners_manual
When installing the balance shaft sprocket, match the plane of the balance shaft on the balance shaft sprocket.

Place the friction shim in the balance shaft sprocket, and align the hole in the middle of the shim with the hole on the sprocket.

![](images/69b7db0e683a10c82d6888fdc4ab70cd7f9b580e87ca47bcfc231537c9354162.webp)

(bHang balance shaft drive chain assembly -D-. When hanging the chain, note that the colored chain links on the chain correspond to the marked points on the crankshaft sprocket (single point) and balance shaft sprocket (double points) respectively.

(Use screw -4-5to install balance shaft drive chain guide assembly-C-. Torque: 7 \~ 11 NбН

(dInstall balance shaft drive chain tensioner arm assembly -Bwith bolt -3-. Torque: 9 \~ 11 NбН   
(e Use bolt -1-2to install balance shaft drive chain tensioner assembly-A-. Torque: 7 \~ 11 NбН   
Remove the balance shaft timing plug -1-.

![](images/ac8f178d92df41c09b5f889f8bb4cae7259e11a2e0a829bef0f2cb8f06eedeaf.webp)

23.Install OCV control valve, intake/exhaust VCT cam sprocket assembly

![](images/e39ca7679cf7b7a4b1ae3a36cc9c9a51b8dac32562ef4f110df93ddbba3f0518.webp)

(aInstall SST (39 GC110085 C) -Aon cylinder head cover -Band fix the intake camshaft. Hint: The exhaust camshaft SST (39 GC110085 C) -Ashall be installed in the same way as the intake camshaft.

![](images/774fe099cbe62a012289db6474dc0bbfc9f7185e53bd18326d0acaef075c2dfd.webp)

Use the OCV -1-2to install the intake and exhaust VCT cam sprockets -A-Bwithout tightening them temporarily. Final torque: 50 NбН+30°

24.Install camshaft timing chain system

![](images/49fd618cfb5cc7de8fef5fe45259e73528e985654e51b6d8ff0b61aeb2703dee.webp)

Install the timing chain assembly -A-.

(Use bolt -4to install chain lubrication nozzle assembly -C-. Torque: 8 \~ 12 N б m

(Use bolt -2-3to install camshaft drive chain guide assembly -2-3-. Torque: 18 \~ 22 NбН   
( Use bolt -1to install camshaft drive chain tensioner arm-A-. Torque: 18 \~ 22 NбН   
(e Use bolt -1-2to install camshaft chain tensioner shim-Band tensioner-C-. Torque: 8 \~ 12 N б m

![](images/a623ed59964918468d9be04ed7f9c6ea234fb759c2393299cf81638309cdc837.webp)

(f) Tighten the OCV -1-2and the exhaust VCT cam sprocket -A-B-. Torque: 50 N б m +30 °

(Remove the crankshaft timing tool SST (39GC110110C) and the camshaft timing tool SST (39GC110085C), and install the bolt. Crankshaft timing adjustment bolt. Torque: 18\~22 N б m camshaft oil passage blockage bolt. Torque: 18\~22 N б m

### Description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_7dfb94c4` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:782 | doc_type:owners_manual
When the crankcase ventilation heater valve circuit voltage is out of the normal range, the ECM records the DTC.

### 7Check cylinder compression pressure
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_bc65bf9b` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:827 | doc_type:owners_manual
Warm up and stop the engine. Hint: The engine coolant temperature is higher than 90 'C , and the engine speed is stable.   
Remove 4 ignition coils.   
( Remove 4 spark plugs.   
Pull off the fuel pump fuse.   
(eInstall a suitable tool to the spark plug hole of cylinder 1 and start the engine to measure cylinder compression pressure. Hint: Compression pressure: 16 - 18 bar Be sure to use a fully charged battery to obtain an engine speed of at least 240 rpm.   
(f) Check the compression pressure of cylinders 1, 2, 3 and 4. Hint: The inspection procedures of cylinders 2, 3, 4 and 1 are the same.   
(Install 4 spark plugs.   
(h) Install 4 ignition coils.   
Install the fuel pump fuse.

`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_6ce0f600` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:854 | doc_type:owners_manual
The positioning lip on the shell back must fall into the corresponding groove, so that the shell back is firmly against the main bearing cap seating surface; No oil or other foreign matters are allowed between the shell back and the main bearing seat surface.

Wipe the main bearing seat surface clean, determine the group of the upper main bearing shell according to the bearing shell matching scheme, and assemble it on the cylinder block main bearing seat.

### Caution:

Drop lubricating oil on the installed main bearing shell to install crankshaft assembly -A-.

Turn it slightly to evenly distribute the lubricating oil on the surface of the crankshaft journal.

### 11Install piston ring
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_c7ccbaf7` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:860 | doc_type:owners_manual
Wipe the piston ring groove clean, ensure no foreign body is in the ring groove, and install the rings in sequence.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_209ac52d` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:861 | doc_type:owners_manual
The side clearance between the first compression ring and the piston ring groove is (0.02\~0.07) mm.

The side clearance between the second compression ring and the piston ring groove is (0.02\~0.06) mm.

The side clearance between oil ring and piston ring groove is (0.04\~0.16) mm.

![](images/abeb48af7c0a82902816dc820a9a4c874aeeb1250a8f67154ff2e7e1194a1d1a.webp)

(Adjust the opening position of each ring as shown in the figure.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_9a7e0dcd` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:862 | doc_type:owners_manual
Adjust the opening position of each ring to ensure that the upper compression ring opening is 180 ° apart from the middle compression ring opening, the spacing between the oil ring and two scraper openings is greater than 60°, and the spacing between the oil ring and the lining ring opening is greater than 30°

The surface of the piston ring with Up mark must be up, and the piston ring should be able to rotate flexibly after being installed into the groove.

### 1Install the piston and connecting rod assembly
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_e1a706ce` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:863 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a Turn the crankshaft so that the crankshaft is near the TDC of 1# cylinder.

According to the connecting rod journal group mark and connecting rod big end hole group mark on the crankshaft, select the connecting rod bearing shell according to the assembly relationship table.

(Install the connecting rod upper bearing shell into the connecting rod bearing shel seat hole.

Hint:

During manual installation, it is necessary to align the bearing shell positioning lip with the groove, and make the shell back against the seat surface of the connecting rod big end hole.

No oil or other foreign matters are allowed between the back of the connecting rod bearing shell and the seat hole.

(dWipe the cylinder bore and spray oil mist around the cylinder bore wall with sprayer.

Hint:

Ensure that an appropriate amount of lubricating oil is applied to the whole circumference of the cylinder within 10 mm from the top surface.

Apply oil to the surface of the piston ring, piston skirt, and connecting rod bearing shell of the piston and connecting rod assembly.

(eCheck whether the split ring position is correct.

Hint:

Ensure that the piston ring opening are staggered with each other, and follow the location distribution diagram of piston ring opening.

Push the piston and connecting rod assembly into the cylinder with a suitable tool.

Hint:

Ensure that the connecting rod and the piston cooling nozzle are not scratched during the pushing process.

( Keep the connecting rod bearing shell firmly fitting against the connecting rod journal; install the connecting rod big end cover with the lower bearing shell into the connecting rod; manually tighten the connecting rod bolt.

Torque: 17 \~ 23 N б m + rotation angle 87 ° \~ 93°

Hint:

When assembling the piston and connecting rod assembly, the forward mark on the piston and the forward mark on the connecting rod shall point to the front end of the engine.

(hTurn the crankshaft so that each connecting rod journal is in the position of TDC and repeat the above steps,

Hint:

Place the engine horizontally with all pistons and connecting rods installed.

When rotating the crankshaft at a constant speed, the allowable range of rotation torque is: (4\~10) Nm.

The seizure phenomenon is not allowed in the rotation process.

### 13Install rear oil seal seat and target wheel assembly
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_759a3fe2` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:864 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/34a8a00d7fcd954b48e586756a2418aedfc8f0fe7e5202a9db74e7deefca31a6.webp)

(Apply engine oil to the crankshaft rear oil seal journal, insert the rear oil seal assembly guide tool into the crankshaft rear end hole and push it against it, put the rear oil seal-Bon the guide tool, slowly push it against the rear end surface of the cylinder block, and remove the rear oil seal guide tool.

Hint:

Tighten sealing flange bolts alternately in a diagonal manner.

Before assembling rear oil seal, please rotate the crankshaft to the TDC of 1# cylinder.

### 14Install flywheel and ring gear assembly
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_841fd7ec` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:865 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/d293587cd5dbcfba828f65ff64289fd07fbdae1c2fa491ed2dfd337cb648a6b6.webp)

Fix the crankshaft, prevent the flywheel from rotating clockwise, and align the dust guard, flywheel and ring gear with the rear end of the crankshaft.

(b The installation sequence of bolts is as shown in the figure, and the fixing bolts of the flywheel-A are cross-mounted.

### 15 Install cylinder head
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_11a8dcfc` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:866 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aClean the bottom surface and front end surface of the cylinder head assembly and dry them with compressed air. Place it onto the cylinder head gasket carefully with the dowel pin hole aligned with the dowel pin on the cylinder block.

![](images/ef51c15f429e9c33eff9507f85b5675eab79d44a529b1235da97caae0d8924c8.webp)

![](images/f25a173bbd443ba3e3a27c8ca46304063a49d68a45aa524e94f6ee439d442c41.webp)

Insert the cylinder head bolt -1-10into the cylinder head bolt holes. The tightening sequence is shown in the figure.

Torque: 38 \~ 42 N б m + (180 ° ± 3 °)

Insert the bolt -1-4into the cylinder head bolt hole and tighten it.

Torque: 10.5\~14.5 N б m

### 16. Install camshaft
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_3161b330` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:867 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aClean the intake/exhaust camshaft assembly and camshaft frame.   
(Apply an appropriate amount of lubricating oil to the camshaft and camshaft frame journals.   
(c) Measure camshaft axial play:(0.09\~0.31) mm.   
(Rotate the camshaft by hand, without obvious seizure.

### 17 Install the timing tool
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_c7bcb246` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:868 | doc_type:owners_manual
Rotate the crankshaft near the 1# cylinder TDC and screw the crankshaft timing tool into the timing hole of the cylinder block.   
Lock the flywheel with a special tool.   
(cInstall SST (39 GC110085 C) -Aon the cylinder head cover and fix the intake and exhaust camshafts.

18Install OCV control valve, intake/exhaust VCT cam sprocket assembly

![](images/7410c35903970b4ca68780553778e888c0e7d70ad7d380bdaa53db407d4d1bf1.webp)

( Use the OCV -1-2-to install the intake and exhaust VCT cam sprockets -A-Bwithout tightening them temporarily.

Final torque: 48 \~ 52 N б m + (30 ° ± 3 °).

### 19Install the camshaft timing chain system
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_b295e1e4` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:869 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/3e96b840ac1a8ffb69d79886fbb1d87ecd8cb203c03d29ee1e069eaa28a491c1.webp)

(Install crankshaft lock washer-C-, crankshaft sprocket-Band crankshaft lock washer-Arespectively.

![](images/4cf5dc6ec922115ee3d9df947d06265d53318d73e05606233a76b0489f0554b5.webp)

Press and hold the tensioner arm return spring - A-, and fit it in the cylinder block hole. Install the oil pump tensioner arm assembly-Cwith the bolt -1-.

Torque: 8 \~ 12 N б m.

Hint:

After installation, check whether the oil pump chain is tensioned and whether the tensioner and its return spring are loose.

![](images/4338b39fc1da5fb81ce68a7ce1b534e3cb2189fe35825c22620cd6cd73ee997c.webp)

(cInstall the timing chain, camshaft drive chain tensioner arm-Aand guide-B-.

Bolt torque of chain guide rail assembly: 8 \~ 12Nб m.

Bolt torque of chain tensioner arm assembly: 18 \~ 22 N б m.

![](images/22010a1ec4f3b3018c68260dfcbf25a36ac7c042c2073f73b01c065609edac58.webp)

( Use bolt -1-2to install camshaft chain tensioner arm-A-.

### Torque: 8 \~ 12 N б m.
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_714ffa0d` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:870 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

Pinch the snap spring on the chain tensioner to make the tensioner plunger pop out and check whether the chain is slack.

(e Tighten the OCV -1-2and the exhaust VCT cam sprocket -A-B-. Torque: 48 \~ 52 N б m + (30 ° ± 3 °)   
(f) Remove the crankshaft timing tool SST (39GC110110C) and the camshaft timing tool SST (39GC110085C), and install the crankshaft timing bolt.

### Check engine oil quality
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_83979837` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:903 | doc_type:owners_manual
(Check whether the engine oil deteriorates and whether the oil is mixed with water, discolored or thinned. If the quality is obviously inferior, replace the engine oil and oil filter element.

### Check engine oil level
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_922430aa` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:904 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aAfter engine warm-up, stop the engine and wait for 5 minutes.   
Check and confirm that the engine oil level is between the minimum oil level mark and maximum oil level mark of the oil dipstick. If the engine oil level is too low, check Check for oil leakage and add oil to the full oil level mark.

### Notice:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_4c3b1ab1` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:905 | doc_type:owners_manual
When filling the engine oil, do not exceed the full oil level mark.

When filling the engine oil, do not allow the oil to spill out of the filler. If the oil spills on the engine gear train, it is necessary to thoroughly clean the oil on the pulley of the gear train and replace the belt; The oil spilled in other parts of the engine needs to be cleaned with cleaner to ensure that there is no residual oil.

Hint:

A certain amount of engine oil will be consumed during driving. In the following cases, the oil consumption will increase and it may be necessary to refill the engine oil during the oil maintenance interval.

When the engine is new, for example, after buying a vehicle or replacing the engine.

If low-quality oil or oil of improper viscosity is used.

When driving with high engine speed or heavy load, towing or frequent acceleration or deceleration during driving.

When the engine is idling for a long time, or when driving frequently in heavy traffic.

### Note:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_724babb3` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:907 | doc_type:owners_manual
Long-term and repeated contact with engine oil will cause the skin to lose the natural oil on the surface, and the skin will become dry, allergic and prone to dermatitis. In addition, the used engine oil contains potentially harmful contaminants that may cause skin cancer.

When changing engine oil, to reduce the hazards caused by skin contact with used engine oil, relevant precautions must be followed. Wear protective clothes and gloves that are impermeable to oil. Wash the skin with soap and water, or thoroughly wash away all used engine oil with a water-free hand cleaner. Do not use gasoline, thinner or solvents.

In order to protect the environment, the oil and oil filter should be disposed of at designated scrapping locations.

### Note:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_cafdb70e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:934 | doc_type:owners_manual
Long-term and repeated contact with engine oil will cause the skin to lose the natural oil on the surface, and the skin will become dry, allergic and prone to dermatitis. In addition, the used engine oil contains potentially harmful contaminants that may cause skin cancer.

When changing engine oil, to reduce the hazards caused by skin contact with used engine oil, relevant precautions must be followed. Wear protective clothes and gloves that are impermeable to oil. Wash the skin with soap and water, or thoroughly wash away all used engine oil with a water-free hand cleaner. Do not use gasoline, thinner or solvents.

In order to protect the environment, the oil and oil filter should be disposed of at designated scrapping locations.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_1f7f8476` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1052 | doc_type:owners_manual
When working close to the electric cooling fan or radiator grille, make sure that the ignition switch is in the OFF position. When the ignition switch is in the ON (IG) position, if the engine coolant temperature becomes high or the A/C is turned ON, the electric cooling fan may start to run automatically.

### Check whether the coolant leaks
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_93fa19b3` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1053 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

To avoid scalding, do not remove the expansion tank pressure cap while the engine and radiator assembly are still hot. Thermal expansion can cause hot engine coolant and steam to escape from the expansion tank.

(aFill the expansion tank with engine coolant, and then connect the reservoir pressure cap tester SST (39GV210540B).   
Pump to 200 kPa, and then check and confirm that the pressure does not decrease. If the pressure drops, check the hose, radiator assembly and coolant pump assembly for leaks. If there is no trace of coolant leakage outside the engine, check the heater core, cylinder block and cylinder head.

![](images/7c5cd55e362ba179d931af76bb54fb9fbb55e8ce1ceef7533588f064d6c9b051.webp)

### Check reservoir coolant level
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_091b33bb` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1054 | doc_type:owners_manual
(When the engine is in cold state, the coolant level shall be between the MAX and MIN scale marks.

Hint:

If the engine coolant level is lower than the MIN mark line, check whether the coolant is leaking, and add the special coolant to the MAX mark line.

### Check the coolant quality
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_0165cb8c` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1055 | doc_type:owners_manual
(Remove the expansion tank pressure cap.

Hint:

To avoid scalding, do not remove the expansion tank pressure cap while the engine and radiator assembly are still hot. Thermal expansion can cause hot engine coolant and steam to escape from the expansion tank.

(Check for excessive rust or scale around the expansion tank pressure cap and expansion tank inlet. There should be no oil in the engine coolant. Hint: If too dirty, change the engine coolant.   
( Use the coolant tester to check the freezing point of the coolant. If it is not within the specified range, change the coolant.

### Check whether the coolant leaks
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_48791120` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1091 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

To avoid scalding, do not remove the expansion tank pressure cap while the engine and radiator assembly are still hot. Thermal expansion can cause hot engine coolant and steam to escape from the expansion tank.

(aFill the expansion tank with engine coolant, and then connect the reservoir pressure cap tester SST (39GV210540B).   
Pump to 200 kPa, and then check and confirm that the pressure does not decrease. If the pressure drops, check the hose, radiator assembly and coolant pump assembly for leaks. If there is no trace of coolant leakage outside the engine, check the heater core, cylinder block and cylinder head.

![](images/3805435d75289ed2df1d3fb368b903ef50daaee74ed364c250e96fa5546f6d95.webp)

### Check reservoir coolant level
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_86a0b72b` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1092 | doc_type:owners_manual
(When the engine is in cold state, the coolant level shall be between the MAX and MIN scale marks.

Hint:

If the engine coolant level is lower than the MIN mark line, check whether the coolant is leaking, and add the special coolant to the MAX mark line -A-.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_a0ecaf93` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1095 | doc_type:owners_manual
Do not change engine coolant with water.

![](images/3ea9beaa1799c9626b97864a73fc083f6fe8dfd7b26c285089d6e81a1ebfd1b8.webp)

(Press the radiator coolant inlet hose and water outlet hose several times by hand to check the coolant level. Caution: If the coolant level is too low, add coolant.   
(dInstall expansion tank pressure cap -A-, to make the engine fully warm up.

![](images/812805c0fe468fe81ffe68811940264185275f172ea21bd2cdc5e93bc4ef35d3.webp)

Bleed the cooling system. Hint:

Turn off the A/C switch before starting the engine.   
Adjust the temperature of the A/C to MAX (HOT).   
Set the A/C blower to Lo.

Press the radiator coolant inlet hose and water outlet hose several times by hand to empty the air in the system.

Hint:

Wear protective gloves when pressing the radiator hose. When the radiator hose is hot, be careful to keep away from the radiator fan.

![](images/0b0d8cc7611c955fde697fd2e23213dc133af118deb25890b01bcdec9c1a9af9.webp)

( After the engine has cooled down, check and confirm that the coolant level is between the MAX and the MIN scale marks -A-.

Hint:

If the coolant level is low, add coolant to the expansion tank to the MAX line.

### Check whether the coolant leaks
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_a4e4e4ea` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1128 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

To avoid scalding, do not remove the expansion tank pressure cap while the coolant and radiator assembly are still hot. Thermal expansion will lead to hot coolant to overflow from the evaporator expansion tank.

![](images/82c72a3de06c99a6fbc697f3721937a12c084f5f094818972fdbb1e2820aafe8.webp)

### Check reservoir coolant level
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_68aeaad2` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1129 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aIn cold state, the coolant level shall be between the MAX and MIN scale marks.

Hint:

If the coolant level is lower than the MIN mark, check whether the coolant is leaking, and add the special coolant to the MAX mark line.

(Check resistance. ( Measure the resistance according to the values in the table below.

Standard resistance:

Check the working condition of fuel pump.

### Notice:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_7360ea35` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1188 | doc_type:owners_manual
To avoid coil burnout, this test must be performed within 5 seconds. •Keep the fuel pump away from the battery as far as possible. •Always energize and de-energize the battery side instead of the fuel pump side.

Use the multimeter to connect the sensor terminal and toggle the float at the same time to read the resistance:

![](images/d10bdfe07fe84aef9d0cdb3b92eb5f1f8f041b2e72da83ce90a2849c09588bc5.webp)

If the resistance value does not match, replace the fuel level sensor.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_c10aed98` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:1200 | doc_type:owners_manual
before carrying out the following work, please carefully read the precautions for high voltage related operation (check and maintenance of high voltage system), and operate in strict accordance with the provisions in the precautions!

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_7ad0e9ec` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:1201 | doc_type:owners_manual
•Failure to properly disconnect the high-voltage loop prior to removal operations on the vehicle may result in serious electric shock accidents or even death. Even after the high-voltage loop is disconnected, the high-voltage battery still has high-voltage. Do not touch the high voltage battery housing and its inside with bare hands.

### Warning:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_98d20041` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:1202 | doc_type:owners_manual
If the vehicle is connected to the charging gun, unplug the charging gun first. The high-voltage capacitors in high-voltage components such as MCU and DC/DC retain some electrical energy after the high voltage system is powered off. The residual electrical energy will be reduced to below 60 VDC within 2 minutes and will be completely released within 5 minutes.   
Place the vehicle power supply in OFF mode.   
After unlocking the service switch, placing the vehicle power supply in the ON mode position may cause a malfunction.

![](images/48ff57ae1b0d8975eae65da63c9806a45be4f947e3554d99185e0b8357546067.webp)

### Notice:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_aa930731` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:1232 | doc_type:owners_manual
the following basic matters must be followed during the installation and removal of the transmission.

### Precautions when handling electronic parts
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_4a9a5bb5` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:1233 | doc_type:owners_manual
When replacing the electronic parts, be sure to place the ignition switch in the OFF position and disconnect the battery negative (-) terminal cable before servicing the system.   
When disconnecting the connector, pull out the connector after unlocking. Notice: Do not pull the harness.   
( When connecting the connector, push the connector until it is fully locked. Tip: Hint: Check and confirm a click is heard.   
(dDo not hit the electronic parts. If the part is dropped or impacted, renew it.

3Prevent contamination with foreign matters

Ensure that dust, sand, etc. are completely removed when removing the relevant parts from the transmission.   
Wrap the removed parts with plastic bags to prevent dust.   
(Carry out maintenance procedures with bare hands or plastic gloves, and do not use work gloves or rags.

### Prevent damage to parts
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_1f4ed876` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1234 | doc_type:owners_manual
( When disassembling the contact surface of the box, knock it with a plastic hammer to separate it. Notice: It is strictly forbidden to use screwdrivers and other tools to pry open the contact surface.   
Do not pull out the solenoid valve or spool valve with excessive force.   
(Install the parts, and check and confirm that the harness, etc. are not stuck.

### Clean the parts
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_f8525e1e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1235 | doc_type:owners_manual
aThoroughly clean all parts, blow dry with gas and apply the specified oil.   
Do not clean aluminum parts and rubber parts with alkaline chemicals.   
(Do not clean the rubber parts with wash oil (white gasoline).

### 6Precautions when handling ATF
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_fed38231` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:1236 | doc_type:owners_manual
Do not drain the high-temperature ATF (repair after the ATF cools down).   
When the ATF splashes onto the floor, wipe it off immediately, as the floor may become slippery and dangerous.   
Be sure to use AW-1 type of ATF.   
(d) Transmission fluid capacity: 6.3 L.

### System description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_eb0e626b` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1239 | doc_type:owners_manual
The TCU detects the electrical signals of the engine and driving status, and controls the shift point according to the driver's habits and road conditions. As a result, fuel efficiency and transmission performance are improved.

In addition, the TCU has the following functions:

Diagnostic function.   
Fail-safe protection function in case of failure.

### Road test
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_31c7a965` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1242 | doc_type:owners_manual
The purpose of the road test is to obtain accurate fault symptoms and check restoration after repairing.

The road test must be carried out under the following conditions:

Be sure to check and adjust the engine before performing these tests.   
•Connect the HQ-VDS to the DLC.   
•The ATF temperature is 50\~80 C under normal driving state.   
•A/C, lights and other systems are turned off.   
Cruise control system is off.

•Secure the HQ-VDS and have another technician operate the HQ-VDS.

### Notice:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_903212ab` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1257 | doc_type:owners_manual
If the AT or TCU is replaced, or the TCU software is rewritten, it is important to initialize the learning value and perform initial learning.

### Initialization requirements
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_4df41de1` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1258 | doc_type:owners_manual
Increase the ATF temperature by idling the vehicle or driving the vehicle in urban areas. Use a special tester to check the ATF temperature and ensure that the temperature is between 15 and 110 °C. If the ATF temperature exceeds this range, operate to keep the temperature within this range.

### Do not attempt to increase the oil temperature by idling the engine.
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_9cb32dfa` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1259 | doc_type:owners_manual
Hint:

If the transmission fluid temperature is not 15\~110 'C , the initial learning cannot be performed. Before the initial learning, check the shift impact or speed change impact.

### Static shift learning
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_21bdd561` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1260 | doc_type:owners_manual
When the vehicle is stationary, depress the brake pedal and place the gearshift lever in the N gear position for 3 seconds. Then, shift from N to D and keep this state for 3 seconds. Repeat the procedure 5 times. Then repeat 5 times in the same way in R position.

### Shift control learning: perform the following procedures
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_9ba1b507` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1261 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aPerform in an environment that allows increasing the vehicle speed to 100 km/h. With the throttle opening between 25% and 35% in the D position, drive the vehicle until it reaches 90 km/h. Then slowly release the accelerator pedal and stabilize the vehicle at 100 km/h for more than 5 seconds. If it is possible to stop or slow down, the vehicle shall slow down by braking gently and stop after 30 seconds. Repeat this procedure 5 times.   
When the above steps cannot be carried out: With the throttle opening between 25% and 35% in the D position, drive the vehicle until it reaches 50 km/h. Then slowly release the accelerator pedal and stabilize the vehicle at 60 km/h for more than 5 seconds. If it is possible to stop or slow down, the vehicle shall slow down by braking gently and stop after 30 seconds. Repeat this procedure 5 times.

### Check the learning results
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_856c0c59` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:1262 | doc_type:owners_manual
Check and verify whether the shift shock and speed change shock are reduced compared to the previous conditions.

### Fail-safe protection
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_ce6943cd` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:1263 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aIn case of fail-safe protection, if the automatic transmission fails in any way, the TCU will output a control signal and control the vehicle to travel the shortest possible distance. If the gearshift solenoid valve fails, the TCM will locate the faulty part as accurately as possible. And make possible gear shifting operation according to the fault location.

### Precautions when handling electronic parts
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_33933952` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:1549 | doc_type:owners_manual
(When replacing the electronic parts, be sure to place the ignition switch in the OFF position and disconnect the battery negative (-) terminal cable before servicing the system.   
When disconnecting the connector, pull out the connector after unlocking. Notice: Do not pull the harness.   
( When connecting the connector, push the connector until it is fully locked. Hint: Check and confirm a click is heard.   
(Do not hit the electronic parts. If the part is dropped or impacted, renew it.

### 3Prevent contamination with foreign matters
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_bb357fe0` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:1550 | doc_type:owners_manual
Ensure that dust, sand, etc. are completely removed when removing the relevant parts from the transmission.   
Wrap the removed parts with plastic bags to prevent dust.

(Carry out maintenance procedures with bare hands or plastic gloves, and do not use work gloves or rags.

### Prevent damage to parts
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_2fe39010` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1551 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aWhen disassembling the contact surface of the box, knock it with a plastic hammer to separate it. Notice: It is strictly forbidden to use screwdrivers and other tools to pry open the contact surface.   
Do not pull out the solenoid valve or spool valve with excessive force.   
(Install the parts, and check and confirm that the harness, etc. are not stuck.

### Clean the parts
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_49601970` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1552 | doc_type:owners_manual
Thoroughly clean all parts, blow dry with gas and apply the specified oil.   
Do not clean aluminum parts and rubber parts with alkaline chemicals.   
Do not clean the rubber parts with wash oil (white gasoline).

### Precautions when handling ATF
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_2f021a14` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1553 | doc_type:owners_manual
(Do not drain the high-temperature ATF (repair after the ATF cools down).   
When the ATF splashes onto the floor, wipe it off immediately, as the floor may become slippery and dangerous.   
(cBe sure to use Castrol BOT351C4 type of ATF.

7. The DTC must be cleared after the fault is eliminated, otherwise the TCU will always record the DTC, which is easy to cause subsequent misunderstanding.

8. When any one of TCU replacement, TCU software upgrade, and transmission (hydraulic module) change occurs, the maintenance or replacement methods of components shall be strictly followed to ensure the normal function and performance of the transmission.

Failure recurrence test: perform the failure recurrence test based on the vehicle working conditions described by the user when the fault occurred.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_6d50d5f1` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1554 | doc_type:owners_manual
Attention shall be paid to "road conditions, engine speed, vehicle speed, acceleration or deceleration, straight or curve driving, time, weather, etc".

### 10.Check connector connection:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_0aed6867` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1555 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aVisually check whether the connector is abnormal, and pay attention to checking whether the insertion and extraction force is abnormal.   
(bAttention shall be paid to checking the cases "the connector is not connected, the terminal is rusted, dust or grease enters the terminal, the terminal is deformed, and the fitting joint is loose".

11. Transient connector poor contact: when the cause of a DTC cannot be determined, it can be considered that the connector has a transient poor contact. Therefore, it is necessary to check and clean the connector, and clear the DTC.

1Clear DTC:

The ignition switch is set to "ON" position;   
(The engine is shut down or idling;   
(The vehicle speed is 0 km/h;   
( The SKA is in P gear;   
(eThe vehicle is braked (the EPB is active or brake pedal depressed). The freeze frame data will be cleared at the same time as the DTC is cleared.

### System description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_2af37f58` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1559 | doc_type:owners_manual
The TCU detects the electrical signals of the engine and driving state, and controls the shift point according to the driver's habits and road conditions. As a result, fuel efficiency and drive axle performance are improved.

By controlling the engine and the drive axle simultaneously, the impact of gear shifting can be reduced.

TCU has a self-diagnosis function.

### DTC priority
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_dec1d744` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1564 | doc_type:owners_manual
1 The DTCs are divided into 8 failure levels. The failure level 1 has the highest priority and failure level 8 has the lowest priority. When there are multiple DTCs, the higher failure level should be handled first until all failures have disappeared. The failure levels can be obtained directly from the HQ-VDS DTC Description.   
2. The DTC level are classified as follows. When there are multiple faults with the same failure level in the system, please handle them in the order shown in the following figure.

### Notice:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_16798df4` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:1565 | doc_type:owners_manual
If either of the transmission, transmission control unit (TCU) or TCU control software changes, confirm whether the calibration data in the TCU control software matches the transmission hydraulic module after replacement. After confirmation, vehicle test shall be carried out to complete the initial self-learning of shift fork position and clutch pressure.

### Static test
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_03f656ce` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1566 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aPower on the vehicle, set IG ON, connect the HQ-VDS, read the DTC, and eliminate the fault;   
(bSKA test: shift the SKA to P-≥R->N-≥D->M->(Tap +)->(Tap-)-≥D-≥N->R->P in sequence, and confirm it is correct through HQ-VDS.

### Vehicle warm-up
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_2dcc13ab` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1567 | doc_type:owners_manual
Increase the engine coolant temperature by idling the vehicle or performing an urban driving cycle. Make sure the engine coolant temperature is higher than 65 C . If the engine coolant temperature is lower than this temperature, selflearning operation cannot be performed.

### Dynamic test
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_5acf6565` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1568 | doc_type:owners_manual
(Place the SKA at the "D" position, release the brake pedal, and depress the accelerator pedal until upshifting to the 7th gear. During the upshifting, keep each gear position for 5 seconds, and keep it for 30 seconds after the vehicle speed reaches 90 km/h;   
Release the accelerator pedal, coast to downshift for 60 seconds, and depress the brake pedal until the vehicle speed is 0;   
(When the engine is at idle speed, push the SKA to the "R" position, release the brake pedal, keep the vehicle driving backward for 5 s, and depress the brake pedal until the vehicle speed is 0;   
(dRepeat the above steps 10 times.

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_9277abd5` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:1569 | doc_type:owners_manual
If a fault is diagnosed in the transmission system, please make sure to follow the processing sequence shown in the table below after the repair or replacement of components. And make sure that there is no other operation between steps (e.g. stepping on the accelerator pedal in D gear position). Before repairing the components, please obtain the transmission assembly number in advance, which can be read in the serial number of the diagnostic scan tool module or obtained from the transmission case.

![](images/7a12a47cdc22d8ca7f37caebca4d91d2f62299b9c607b8b7f0c4306aca1a0bda.webp)

3. DCT characteristic data writing: the mechanical characteristics data of the DCT transmission is written in four categories: hydraulic characteristic data, clutch pressure self-learning data, shift fork position self-learning data and clutch spring pressure self-learning data. Each transmission has a separate set of characteristic data. When replacing the TCU or transmission, all characteristic data needs to be rewritten.

Programming preparation

( One diagnostic scan tool;   
()Transmission characteristic data file.

(Programming conditions

( Operation steps

(1Connect the HQ-VDS;   
Follow the HQ-VDS prompts to enter the transmission number for writing DCT feature data;   
(3) After the programming is completed, the HQ-VDS prompts that the programming is successful;   
(4 Turn off the ignition to save the data automatically.

4. Clear the transmission characteristic data: clear the transmission characteristic data saved in the TCU.

Programming conditions (The vehicle ignition switch is powered on, at which point the instrument cluster lights up; The engine is not started; The gearshift lever is in the P gear position.

### Transmission self-learning
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_59795796` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:1571 | doc_type:owners_manual
Transmission characteristic data adjustment is required with the help of HQ-VDS when processing some DTCs. When there is driving difference before and after replacing the TCU or transmission, the self-learning can also be required for adjustment. Note: The self-learning sequence must be fork self-learning, clutch pressure self-learning, and clutch KissPoint point self-learning.

### Shift fork position self-learning

(aProgramming preparation: one diagnostic scan tool;

(Programming conditions:

(Set the ignition switch to "ON";   
Start the engine and keep it at idle speed;   
( The gearshift lever is in the N gear position;   
(4) The vehicle is in braking state and keeps stationary;   
( There is no DTC;   
(6)The transmission fluid temperature is higher than 20°C.

( Operation steps:

(1Connect the HQ-VDS;   
Operate the HQ-VDS to start the shift fork position self-learning;   
(3) After the self-learning is completed, the HQVDS prompts that the self-learning is successful, and the process takes about 1 min;   
(4 Turn off the ignition to save the data automatically.

### Drain ATF
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_ed9e401b` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:drivetrain | p:1859 | doc_type:owners_manual
(Park the vehicle on a lifting platform or assembling service pit, in a horizontal position, with the shift lever in "P" gear position.   
Read the transmission fluid temperature which should be between 35 C -45 C . If the fluid temperature is too low, preheat the transmission fluid to this temperature.   
(Remove oil drain plug assembly -1and gasket - 2-. Hint: After removal, all oil in the transmission case will flow out, and the container shall be prepared in advance to collect oil.

(Drain the transmission fluid and condition the transmission until no transmission fluid flows out or for 10 min.

Hint:

The discharged oil volume is about 5.5 L. Please prepare a container with appropriate capacity to receive the oil.

Due to the structural characteristics of the DCT, there is still a certain amount of transmission fluid inside the transmission that cannot be discharged, which is normal and does not need to be discharged completely.

![](images/358ebf00b92c906750ea0f0c82de2e4d5855e40af8a2acf163943cf1517e5db1.webp)

(eInstall the gasket and oil drain plug assembly -1-. Torque: 19 \~ 29 NбН

### . ACM overview
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_093ad96c` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1901 | doc_type:owners_manual
The ACM receives the shift information through the CAN to complete the shift action. The ACM has a diagnostic function.

Description of ACM anti-theft function (After the ignition switch is turned on, the ACM performs anti-theft authentication communication with the BCM. If the anti-theft authentication is passed, gear shifting is allowed; If the anti-theft authentication is not passed, gear shifting is not allowed, and authentication failure information is sent to the BCM and ECM.

### Removal and installation of battery terminal
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_893ffe2a` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:1950 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aBefore removal and repair of electrical components, disconnect the battery negative (-) terminal to prevent the system from short circuit.   
(Before disconnecting or reconnecting the battery cable, first turn off the ignition and lighting switch, and then completely loosen or tighten the battery cable terminal nut.   
(c) When reconnecting after disconnecting the battery cable, some systems need to be initialized.

### General repair instructions
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_4e6d2de7` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:1951 | doc_type:owners_manual
(During maintenance, take and place electronic component (ECU, sensor, etc.) carefully to avoid injuries caused by impact and static electricity.   
(Establish awareness of environmental protection and effectively dispose of wastes generated during maintenance.   
(c) It is not recommended to use the method of piercing the wire skin to detect the electrical signals input and output of the part, so as to avoid harness short circuit.

Precautions for gear shifting

Gently operate the gearshift lever and ensure that the gear shifting is correct.   
Release the gearshift lever to reset after each gear shifting.   
(c) The vehicle adopts an electronic shift mechanism, which needs to be operated according to the gear position indication information on the instrument cluster and information display.

### Precautions
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_a090a16a` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:2008 | doc_type:owners_manual
1ENGINE START/STOP button (ignition switch) representation:

![](images/69d858d0181c149ef6db0b0e2f0389c4d041dae4cff872a66b4b48d5ccaf11ad.webp)

Some systems require initialization when reconnecting after disconnecting the battery cable.

3. When repairing the SRS, it is necessary to pay attention to the cleaning of harnesses and connectors of electrical components. When disconnecting the connector, the connector and electrical components shall be protected to prevent foreign matters from entering and affecting the normal operation of the system. (For example, abnormal airbag resistance is caused)

### General precautions
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_f85d4d96` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:2009 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aThe airbag assembly and pretensioner shall not be removed at will. If necessary, they shall be disassembled and assembled by professional maintenance personnel.   
Do not change the airbag assembly and pretensioner and their surrounding layout without authorization.   
(Disconnect the battery negative terminal. First check the DTC, then turn off the ignition switch, and disconnect the negative terminal of the battery and wait for 90 seconds before starting the operation.   
(dWhen removing and installing the airbag assembly, the upper surface (marked side) of the airbag shall face upward. Do not place the airbag on another airbag during storage. (If the metal surface of the airbag is placed upward, once the airbag accidentally explodes, it will lead to a serious accident)   
(eThe battery negative terminal shall be disconnected for more than 90 seconds before electric welding operations.   
(f) Eliminate SRS faults in time, otherwise serious consequences will occur. One is that when the car is in a serious collision and the airbag needs to be deployed for protection, it cannot work; The other is that in the normal operation of the vehicle, the airbag should not work, but suddenly deploy, causing undue accidental injuries to the driver and passengers, and even safety accidents.   
(9) It is prohibited to measure the resistance of SRS parts. (It may cause the airbag to deploy accidentally, which is very dangerous)   
(h) Do not apply butter to the airbag assembly and do not wash it with any type of detergent.   
(i) Avoid accidental bumps and vibrations. Airbag assembly sensor and other components are sensitive to collision and impact, thus collision and impact shall be avoided as much as possible to avoid unnecessary sudden deployment of airbag assembly and pretensioner.   
(j) Keep airbag assembly components in strict accordance with the specifications. Inflammable and explosive materials such as gunpowder and detonator in the airbag assembly must be transported and stored in strict accordance with the specifications, otherwise serious consequences will be caused.   
(k) When the vehicle is abandoned or the airbag is abandoned separately, the airbag shall first be deployed with a special tool: (It is strictly forbidden to discard it without opening. (2) Be sure to deploy the airbag and pretensioner in a safe and flat place outdoors. Try not to do it in residential areas. (3) The explosion sound when the airbag and pretensioner are deployed is very loud, so the surrounding people must be informed in advance.   
Pay attention to daily check. Mainly check

whether each fixed impact sensor is firm, whether the ground wires are clean, whether the connection is reliable, etc.

(m The airbag must be used in conjunction with the seat belt. Airbags are passive safety devices and can only be used in conjunction with seat belts to achieve satisfactory safety protection, so you must wear your seat belt when the car is running.

### Precautions for clock spring
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_9a2c04dd` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:2010 | doc_type:owners_manual

### Caution:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_92b47814` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:2011 | doc_type:owners_manual

### System description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_19e5f167` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2016 | doc_type:owners_manual
ACU function overview

The ACU is the center of the entire restraint system. It can sense the acceleration changes of the vehicle during the frontal and side impact, and then control the corresponding detonating components. Minimize the injuries of the driver and passengers in the vehicle to achieve the purpose of protecting the occupants in the vehicle.

### System fault warning function
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_c6389c2c` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:2017 | doc_type:owners_manual
(The SRS fault warning lamp is located inside the IPC. The drive current of the system fault warning lamp is provided by the pull-up power supply inside the IPC. The ACU airbag control unit does not provide this voltage.

### 3Vehicle speed signal receiving function
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_b3102f5e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2018 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aThe ACU obtains vehicle speed signal related information through the CAN bus. The ACU will sample this signal at the time of impact and will record this signal in the EDR (event data record).

### Collision output
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_5ea5cf64` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:2019 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a When the ACU senses an impact signal and deploys any safety device, the ACU shall send an impact signal to BCM and EMS to unlock the door lock and cut off the fuel circuit for the safety of personnel in the vehicle.

### General repair instructions
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_840d3c3f` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:body | p:2311 | doc_type:owners_manual
When the part needs to be replaced or the connector needs to be disconnected during maintenance of A/C system, disconnect the battery negative cable.   
The door control system needs to be initialized after reconnecting the battery. And use the HQVDS to "clear the DTC" for all electronic control systems.

Do not open the high pressure manifold valve during compressor operation.

(Open and close the low-pressure valve only. If the high-pressure valve is opened, the refrigerant flows in reverse direction, causing the filling cylinder to rupture.

4. Do not run the engine and compressor without refrigerant, otherwise the inside of the compressor will be damaged, because the compressor parts are always running regardless of A/C system on or off.

The refrigerant must be R134a.

6. Do not handle the refrigerant in a confined environment or near an open flame.   
7. Use R134a specific equipment for recycling and filling. Always wear goggles when working.

Maintenance precautions:

If the liquid refrigerant splashes into the eyes or onto the skin: Wash these parts with plenty of cold water and do not rub eyes or skin. Apply clean Vaseline to the skin. (Immediately go to the hospital for professional treatment.

9. It is forbidden to heat the container for storing refrigerant or expose the container to open fire, and do not cause the container for storing refrigerant to fall or be impacted.

10Do not run the compressor when the refrigerant in the refrigerant system is insufficient.

11Take care not to add excessive refrigerant into the system. If the refrigerant is overfilled, it will cause problems such as insufficient cooling and compressor liquid impact.

12.Pay attention to checking whether the A/C system leaks. (a The A/C system shall be checked for leakage on time in accordance with the owner's manual.

1Compressor oil.

(aCompressor oil grade: SP-10 or equivalent.   
Due to the high moisture absorption of the compressor oil, the A/C components should be immediately isolated from the air with plugs or plastic tape when they are removed.

### 14General precautions:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_d15a036a` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:2312 | doc_type:owners_manual
When detecting the battery voltage during the test, do not keep the positive and negative probes of the detector too close to avoid short circuit.

### Check compressor oil amount
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_3b11fb97` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:2313 | doc_type:owners_manual
![](images/21dccc29ecd01f464e2ab548ca03ed034406fb89fdc47addf7904e11c1077fcd.webp)

(Replace the compressor.

( After the old compressor is removed, pour all the compressor oil in the compressor into the measuring cup (the poured oil X [g]).   
(If the new compressor is pre-filled with compressor oil, pour all the compressor oil into a clean measuring cup.   
(Add X[g] new oil (the same amount of oil poured out from the old compressor) to the new compressor.   
(4If no compressor oil is pre-filled in the new compressor, X[g] new oil needs to be added.

Hint:

The amount of oil pre-filled in the compressor is about 75 ml. During operation, prevent foreign matter and moisture from entering the compressor and compressor oil.

(Replace other A/C system assembly components

When replacing the condenser, add about 20 ml of compressor oil.   
When installing a new evaporator, add 20 ml of compressor oil.   
(When replacing the refrigerant pipeline, add 5 ml of compressor oil for each pipe replaced.

(Compressor oil specifications ( Use the specified compressor oil, otherwise the compressor will be damaged.

![](images/496a6d193257bceaa7b6181872872ede254dcb58b75e2cee049aba3b26a2676e.webp)

### Check condenser assembly
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_04f2b95c` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2314 | doc_type:owners_manual
When the radiator fins of the condenser assembly are dirty, clean them with water and then blow them dry with compressed air.   
( When the radiator fins of the condenser assembly are bent, straighten them with screwdriver or pliers.

Do not damage the condenser assembly fins.
### Check whether the refrigerant gas leaks
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_7fac5668` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2316 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aUse a halogen leak detector to check whether there is air leakage at the joint of the piping.   
When there is air leakage at the joint of piping, confirm the torque of standard parts for the joint of piping.

### Change the refrigerant
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_f5d5d804` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:2317 | doc_type:owners_manual
Recover the refrigerant in cooling system Start engine. Operate the cooler compressor under the conditions indicated below:

![](images/d27d22bd26cd0b9325f9cd311590fac89e7772105987b3cd1913ffc3684bf474.webp)

Most of the compressor oil in the various parts of A/C system is collected into the A/C compressor.

Shut down the engine.

Recover refrigerant from A/C system using refrigerant recovery unit. Hint: Please follow the manufacturer's instructions to use the refrigerant recovery unit.

(Fill the A/C system with refrigerant (Use a vacuum pump or suitable equipment for vacuum cleaning. Fill the A/C system with refrigerant.

![](images/92c8d4f18ff305614d3e35abd844527a737e35cfff59e7b7c927ab3568caf28e.webp)

Hint:

The amount of old oil separated after the refrigerant is recovered by the refrigerant recovery machine is recorded as (Y [g]), then the same amount of new oil (Y [g]) is added to the A/C system, and then the vacuum pumping is started.

Hint:

When using the refrigerant recovery unit, make sure there is enough refrigerant to fill the system. The refrigerant recovery unit can not recover 100% of the refrigerant in the air conditioning system.

(Compressor warm-up

Run the compressor at low speed for 3-5 minutes to warm up the compressor.

Hint:

When turning on the A/C after removing and installing the A/C system pipeline (including the compressor), be sure to warm up the compressor to prevent damage.

Check whether the efrigerant is leaking.

(After refilling the A/C system with refrigerant, check the refrigerant for leakage with a halogen leak detector.

Test under the following conditions:

Set the ignition switch to OFF position Ensure good ventilation (halogen leak detector may react to volatile gases that are not refrigerant, such as gasoline vapors and exhaust gases). Repeat the check two or three times. Measure the pressure to confirm that there is refrigerant remaining in the A/C system.

![](images/10c05ba422ed9628f1e923531d8442f91476336a32a844f733d30514b9e588a9.webp)

Use the halogen leak detector to check the A/C system for refrigerant leakage.

![](images/0bc030859dd557d7263f9363419d4bcb7b4b55f4dea2717da2a36853f31df2bb.webp)

Power off the halogen leak detector, bring it close to the drain hose, and then turn on the detector.

Hint: After the blower motor stops, leave the cooling device under no load for more than 15 minutes. Place the halogen leak detector sensor under drain hose. When approaching the drain hose, ensure that the halogen leak detector does not react to volatile gases. If the interference of volatile gas cannot be avoided, the vehicle shall be raised to check for leakage.   
(If no refrigerant leakage is detected at the drain hose, remove the blower motor control unit from the cooling unit. Insert the halogen leak detector sensor into the unit and check for leaks.   
(6) Disconnect the pressure sensor connector and condition it for about 20 minutes. Place the halogen leak detector sensor close to the pressure sensor and check for leaks. Hint: When checking for leakage, the presence of oil at the connection indicates that there is leakage.

### Function brief description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_842f22d2` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2320 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aThis vehicle is equipped with a dual temperature zone A/C system, which can provide the required driving environment for occupants by automatically adjusting the air outlet temperature, air volume, air outlet mode and air inlet mode according to the temperature set by the occupants in the vehicle, combined with the current interior temperature, ambient temperature, sunlight intensity, vehicle speed, water temperature and other environmental parameters.   
Touch the IVI A/C setting column to enter the A/C interface.   
(cThe A/C system can be set through the A/C operation panel.   
2. AQS: The system automatically detects the air quality outside the vehicle. When the outside air is polluted, the A/C system automatically switches to recirculation to prevent the polluted air from entering the vehicle to ensure the air quality inside the vehicle.   
3. Fragrance diffuser system: After selecting the appropriate fragrance diffuser mode and level, the system will cooperate with the A/C to improve the interior environment and improve the comfort of drivers and passengers.

The following examples are manifold gauge assembly readings and corresponding A/C system faults.

(Read the manifold gauge pressure when the following conditions are met:

Park the vehicle in the shade.   
The door is fully open.   
Engine runs at 2000 rpm.   
Turn on the A/C switch.   
•A/C is switched to recirculation mode.   
The temperature is set to the lowest value.   
The blower speed is set to high speed.   
The air inlet temperature is 30°C to 35°C.

The A/C system works properly.

Pressure gauge reading ( The A/C system works abnormally. During operation, the pressure on the low pressure side is cycled between normal and vacuum

![](images/b81936bd3c7722c6aec8255579aca73fc5113fdf032ecf7cc443a4ee95935344.webp)

![](images/9f1482130b807be4098dc4de9b58449777186e9c9f4061870d9439a630d0609b.webp)

![](images/cfdafcd741e4122c0421cb8bce792f32baa406ebfe29ea5223cb107c69c555b3.webp)

Hint:

In the above example, the refrigerant circulation is poor.

![](images/3cf7717c6f8eb1cc14783b0955d8590ec853e15ed0a17eab8ff551af669368d2.webp)

(4Vacuum on low pressure side, and very low pressure on high pressure side

### Recycling of refrigerant in cooling system
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_19b80863` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:2462 | doc_type:owners_manual
Start the engine.   
Operate the cooler compressor under the conditions indicated below:

![](images/5eecc8b6624f4113c0fd862f7f497ab25ee4624be53e15382974521f5ffc78c6.webp)

This allows most of the compressor oil from the various parts in A/C system to be collected into the A/C compressor.

Hint:

If A/C does not work due to compressor locking, there is no need to operate the cooler compressor.

(Stop the engine.   
(dRecover refrigerant from A/C system using refrigerant recovery unit. Hint: Please follow the manufacturer's instructions to use the refrigerant recovery unit.

### Compressor oil specifications
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_90b4bbac` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:2463 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a Use the specified compressor oil, otherwise the compressor will be damaged.

![](images/d9d828ecea0c2223d8c65e783720eacd789ffdd833d5385672b3141335869196.webp)

### Refrigerant designation
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_afd34d53` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2464 | doc_type:owners_manual
Use the specified refrigerant, otherwise the compressor will be damaged.

![](images/455d41349c9d1f82f53b872bb60ef7c288ac884a23e39e6b1de37981967fab1b.webp)

Perform vacuum cleaning with vacuum pump or suitable equipment, and fill the A/C system with refrigerant.

![](images/fe1ba9ea495058fc643625beaccb6a8097ae314e6e00856a087a58d07cf92303.webp)

![](images/d44352fa46b3f9ee7fdbe1458f393238fc6fd6a6b916295723cc524add5f2b1e.webp)

Hint:

Do not turn on the A/C switch before filling the A/C system with refrigerant. Otherwise, it may make the compressor work without refrigerant, causing overheating of the compressor. •The refrigerant level shall be checked according to the quantity (weight).

Hint:

When using the refrigerant recovery unit, make sure there is enough refrigerant to fi the system. The refrigerant recovery unit can not recover 100% of the refrigerant in the air conditioning system.

### Warm up compressor
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_e9ad99c8` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2465 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aKeep the A/C switch on for at least 2 minutes to allow the compressor to warm up.

Hint:

When turning on the A/C after removing and installing the A/C system pipeline (including the compressor), be sure to warm up the compressor to prevent damage.

### Check whether the refrigerant leaks
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_c3457b71` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:2466 | doc_type:owners_manual
After refilling the A/C system with refrigerant, check the refrigerant for leakage with a halogen leak detector.   
Test under the following conditions: Set the ignition switch to OFF position

Ensure good ventilation (halogen leak detector may react to volatile gases that are not refrigerants, such as gasoline  vapors and exhaust gases). •Repeat the check two or three times. Measure the pressure to confirm that there is refrigerant remaining in the A/C system.

![](images/06ea3825de1ba10230514d8a26138ffec146e3b3ce34fad4ac09ca32a72f5b46.webp)

(Use the halogen leak detector to check the A/C system for refrigerant leakage.

Power off the halogen leak detector, bring it close to the drain hose, and then turn on the detector. Hint:

After the blower motor stops, leave the cooling device under  no load for more than 15 minutes. Place the halogen leak detector sensor under drain hose. When approaching the drain hose, ensure that the halogen leak detector does not react to volatile gases. If the interference of volatile gas cannot be avoided, the vehicle shall be raised to check for leakage.   
(e If no refrigerant leakage is detected at the drain hose, remove the blower motor control unit from the cooling unit. Insert the halogen leak detector sensor into the unit and check for leaks.   
(f) Disconnect the pressure sensor connector and condition it for about 20 minutes. Place the halogen leak detector sensor close to the pressure sensor and check for leaks.

Hint:

When checking for leakage, the presence of oil at the connection indicates that there is leakage.

### Function brief description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_7229972d` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:2544 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a The APA has functions of automatic parking in and automatic parking out.

The APA can identify the side, vertical and oblique parking, and automatically park the vehicle backwards, supporting the automatic parking out function in horizontal and vertical parking spaces.

### Operating principle
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_68ffd014` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:sensors | p:2545 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a When the vehicle is in APA mode, the ADV sends a enable signal to the PA ECU through the CAN bus, and the system starts to work until the АPA process ends.   
( When the vehicle is in the APA mode, the PA ECU needs to collect the real-time information of the sensor, calculate the vehicle position and size, the real-time distance information of obstacles, etc., and output it to the ADV through the CAN bus. The ADV conducts trajectory planning and calculation according to the information, and conducts horizontal and vertical control of the vehicle until the parking process is completed.

### . APA prompt
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_5b0f53d3` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:infotainment | p:2546 | doc_type:owners_manual
(a The PA ECU sends obstacle distance information and classification alarm to the EnHost, and EnHost gives video and audio prompts.   
During the working process of the system, the PA ECU continuously monitors the normal functions of sensors and peripheral circuit. If any fault is found, it will be classified and saved into the memory and sent to the EnHost through the bus, and the EnHost will give an alarm.

`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_41f0e9e6` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:2586 | doc_type:owners_manual
(When checking the IFC, the airbag system may be affected. Therefore, before carrying out maintenance work, be sure to carefully read and confirm the precautions for airbag.   
Weather conditions may affect the monitoring of the IFC, thus careful driving is required.   
(c) The driver is the primary operator of a vehicle and his/her control on the vehicle takes precedence over the IFC. The driver shall take over the vehicle according to the actual conditions to ensure the driving safety of the vehicle.

After replacing the IFC, use the HQ-VDS for calibration.

Establish awareness of environmental protection and effectively dispose of wastes generated during maintenance.   
(c) It is not recommended to use the method of piercing the wire skin to detect the electrical signals input and output of the part, so as to avoid harness short circuit.

### DMS function overview
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_1872953e` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2699 | doc_type:owners_manual
( The DMS can provide different vehicle modes, and vehicles have unique driving performance in different modes to meet driving needs.

Switching of driving mode: by turning the DMS button, four driving modes of customization, sport, comfort and economy can be switched cyclically; Four driving modes of customization, sport, comfort and economy can be selected in the vehicle settings of the IVI.

### Driving mode
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_3a50a4fc` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:general | p:2700 | doc_type:owners_manual
(aEconomy mode: In the economic mode, the vehicle has good economy and is suitable for running on common urban pavements.   
(Comfort mode: In the comfort mode, the vehicle can provide good comfort and is suitable for running on common urban pavements.   
(Sport mode: In the sport mode, the vehicle is highly dynamic and suitable for running on highways or common urban pavements.   
(dCustom mode: In order to meet the personalized driving needs, in addition to the above driving modes, the driver can also select a custom mode.

Hint:

Using the HQ-VDS reading data recorder, the values or status of switch, sensor, actuator and other items can be read without removing any parts. This detection method can be used to find intermittent failure or signals. Reading the data recorder information can save diagnostic time when troubleshooting.

### Warning:
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_a2d08ca2` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:ev | p:2894 | doc_type:owners_manual
Before repairing the high voltage system or adjacent high voltage system components, be sure to carefully read the "Instructions and precautions for maintenance work" in the introduction carefully!

Replace the damaged high-voltage harness in time.

(c) High-voltage electrical connection parts such as high-voltage harness must be in a dry state during assembly, and the connected metal parts must be bright.

(dPersons wearing electronic/medical life and health maintenance devices (e. g. with pacemakers) are not permitted to approach electric vehicles.

(eThe measuring instrument used must be approved and within the validity period.

(f) After insulation failure, the high voltage components shall not be contacted, because the case can be conductive.

(When removing the high voltage system, special tools for electricians shall be used.

(h) Tools with insulation protection shall be used when working on the inside of the traction battery.

(i) Be extra careful when checking and fixing the high voltage system or high voltage components that are flooded (high voltage component with snow melting salts are particularly dangerous).

(Before disconnecting or reconnecting the battery cable terminal, first turn off the power (ignition) switch and lighting switch, and then completely loosen or tighten the battery cable terminal nut.   
When reconnecting after disconnecting the battery cable, some systems need to be initialized.

(a Adopt permanent magnet synchronization drive motor, permanent magnet synchronization alternator, motor inverter and reducer.

### Function brief description
`hongqi_hongqi_h5_en_69293a8a` | hongqi_h5 | pdf_manual | tier:2 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:2901 | doc_type:owners_manual
( The high-voltage DC power supply is converted into three-phase AC with adjustable voltage amplitude and frequency through DC/AC (inverter) to drive the permanent magnet synchronous motor to operate.   
(MCU communicates with HCU through the CAN bus, obtains the torque command and operation mode of drive motor and alternator respectively from the HCU, obtains the current and motor position signals according to the feedback of drive motor and alternator, controls the drive motor and the alternator to generate the required three-phase alternating current, and outputs the command torque respectively.

(aConnect the HQ-VDS and read the DTC.

(aA service technician needs to have the low-voltage electrician certificate and technical training certificate to repair the vehicle using this manual.   
High voltage protection shall be provided during maintenance.
